news.Title: Elon Musk Is Going All In on Nvidia, but Are These Two Chip Stocks Better Buys?
news.Content:
Elon Musk made waves when he announced that Space Exploration Technologies would exclusively use Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA) chips going forward. It was a big coup for the graphics processing unit (GPU) maker and is sure to bring in hundreds of billions of dollars in revenue in the coming years.

However, Nvidia is not the only artificial intelligence (AI) semiconductor stock in town, and Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ: AMD) and Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO) could actually be the better investments. Here's why.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Training vs. inference

Nvidia made its mark in AI model training, and there is little doubt it will remain the leader in this space. When the company developed its CUDA software platform to program its GPUs, it smartly gave the software away for free and seeded it in places doing early work on AI.

The result was a generation of developers trained on its software, with most foundational AI code written using its software and optimized for its chips. This moat in training still holds strong today.

While the AI training segment remains strong, inference is growing faster and is projected to become a much larger market in the coming years. According to Bloomberg Intelligence, the inference market is projected to grow at a 32% compound annual growth rate until 2032, reaching $1.3 trillion, which would be about double the $658 billion it expects the AI training segment to reach over the same time period.

This is important because inference is less technically demanding than training, and Nvidia's CUDA moat is not nearly as wide. Inference is also less about raw compute power and more about quick access to memory; since inference is an ongoing cost, cost-per-inference becomes a very important factor.

AMD and Broadcom: Big inference opportunities ahead

This opens the door for both AMD and Broadcom to become major players in the inference market. AMD's GPUs are much cheaper than Nvidia's, and it has nicely improved its ROCm software platform over the past few years. Meanwhile, its chiplet design can be packaged with more high bandwidth memory (HBM), making its GPUs well-suited for inference.

It's also made a lot of moves in memory, including its acquisitions of the memory optimization company MEXT and the inference chip designer Taalas. In addition, its new Veral chips for edge computing incorporate on-chip SRAM (static random-access memory) to reduce reliance on off-chip memory during inference. Finally, it has also partnered with Cerebras for a high-end inference offering, where Cerebras' ultra-fast but expensive chips handle the decode phase of inference while its GPUs handle the pre-fill phase, helping it compete directly against Nvidia following its deal with Groq.

Story Continues

AMD already has two $100 billion multiyear deals in place with OpenAI and Meta Platforms , and it recently announced that Anthropic and Microsoft are also GPU customers. On top of that, it is a leader in server central processing units (CPUs), a market it sees growing to $220 billion in the coming years due to the rise of agentic AI.

Broadcom is also set to become a big player in the inference market. The company is a leader in ASICs (application-specific integrated circuits), which are custom chips hardwired to perform certain tasks. While they are less flexible than GPUs, they are high-performance and use less power than general-purpose GPUs, making them particularly attractive for reducing inference costs.

Instead of making its own AI chips, Broadcom helps customers turn their designs into physical AI chips that can be manufactured at scale. It helped Alphabet co-design its highly regarded Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), which are set to be its biggest growth driver, both internally and by selling these chips to Anthropic. Broadcom has also helped OpenAI and Meta Platforms design their own custom chips.

As these programs ramp up, it sees its AI revenue doubling next fiscal year to $115 billion, then doubling again to $230 billion in fiscal 2028.

Nvidia, AMD, and Broadcom all have strong growth ahead from the AI infrastructure build-out, but AMD and Broadcom could be set to outperform their larger rival given their positions in the inference market and growth off of a smaller base. That makes them the better AI stocks to buy, despite Musk's endorsement.

news.Title: 〈滙豐經濟展望〉估Fed 12月再升息1碼 AI助攻台灣企業獲利、經濟成長動能強
news.Content:
滙豐銀行今(23)日舉行2026年第四季投資展望線上記者會，滙豐私人銀行及財富管理北亞首席投資總監何偉華指出，儘管過去數月半導體股價波動、美國利率變動及地緣政治等因素交織，但全球經濟與企業盈利仍優於市場預期。其中，台灣將繼續受惠於 AI 數據中心發展，雖下半年基期較高，未來的經濟與企業盈利成長前景依然樂觀，因此維持對全球股票的偏高配置，固定收益也具顯著機遇。滙豐預估美國聯準會 12 月將再升息 1 碼，2027 年則按兵不動。

滙豐私人銀行表示，全球主要經濟體的經濟驚喜指數多呈現正向，且製造業受惠於 AI 快速發展，對資料中心與半導體投資強勁，加上全球油價與大宗商品價格支撐，帶動整體製造業穩定成長。在通膨與利率方面，雖然美國通膨壓力仍存，使得美國聯準會於9月採取升息行動，但通膨數據仍在可控預期內，金融市場流動性對通膨產生的壓力相對穩定。

針對市場高度關注的美國利率政策，何偉華進一步指出，滙豐預估Fed在12月仍有再升息1碼(25個基點)的可能性，主要由於通膨回落至2%目標水平仍需時間，預計要到2028年，加上美國經濟增長強勁。

不過何偉華認為，升息對股市估值影響有限，且預測明年Fed將維持利率不動。在匯市方面，受鷹派政策、能源自給優勢及選後資金回流支撐，美元指數短線仍看升；日元在政府干預與利差因素抵銷下將呈區間震盪；離岸人民幣則受惠於中國強勁出口貿易順差與人民幣國際化政策推動，中長期將呈現溫和升值走勢。

在資產配置策略上，滙豐維持對全球股市「加碼」的立場。何偉華分析，全球約有 70% 的企業盈利預測獲得上調，市場盈利增長動力極強。針對市場關注的科技股估值問題，何偉華認為，經過第二季的股價修正後，美股科技股的估值已回落至合理水平，與非科技股差異不大，且科技業盈利增長顯著，因此「不需過度擔憂科技股存在泡沫」。

針對即將到來的11月美國期中選舉，滙豐研究過去 24 次期中選舉歷史數據顯示，雖然選前股市易受訊息面影響而波動，但在選後 12 個月內，有 22 次股市皆呈現上揚走勢。滙豐預期在不確定性消除後，市場將重新回歸基本面與合理估值，美股表現依舊看好。

就區域市場而言，滙豐看好美國、日本，以及包含台灣、南韓在內的北亞市場。針對債券與另類資產，滙豐指出，目前實質利率已處於具吸引力的偏高水平，建議投資人可持有所屬優質公司債至到期；同時搭配對沖基金、私募市場及黃金等資產，以提升多元投資組合的抗震韌性。

news.Title: “The New Clippy”: Benioff Uses Salesforce’s Biggest Product Launch in Years to Challenge Microsoft
news.Content:
Marc Benioff is never one to pass up a chance to take a jab at Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ: MSFT ), and Dreamforce 2026 was no different. The Salesforce CEO used the company's flagship annual conference in San Francisco to announce AIforce, the biggest product launch Salesforce, Inc. (NYSE: CRM ) has made in years, and to once again refer to Microsoft's Copilot as "the new Clippy," doubling down on a dig he made two years ago.

What AIforce Actually Does

Salesforce is positioning AIforce as an open, provider-agnostic layer rather than a single proprietary assistant. It's intended to work across multiple AI systems, including Anthropic's Claude, via a specific integration called Claudeforce, which Salesforce claims guarantees zero data retention by the model provider, as well as ChatGPT, Slack, and other environments. Salesforce, Inc. (NYSE:CRM) made the announcement alongside an additional strategic marker: a fiscal 2030 revenue target of $63 billion, which management reiterated at Dreamforce.

A Rivalry That Goes Back To 2024

Benioff portrayed AIforce as the solution to what he calls the "Fantasyland" problem, arguing that competing AI solutions, including Copilot, lack the dependable, controlled business-data layer required to consistently run enterprise operations. It's a continuation of a public feud that's been going on since at least Dreamforce 2024, when Benioff first compared Copilot to Clippy, Microsoft's widely mocked, uninvited desktop assistant from the late 1990s, saying, "We all know now that Microsoft Copilot is basically the new Microsoft Clippy, that customers have not gotten value from it." He's returned to that theme several times since, including at Davos, in an October 2024 written critique saying that Microsoft "lacks the data, metadata, and enterprise security models to create real corporate intelligence," and on a podcast where he labeled Copilot a "tremendous disservice" to the AI sector.

Favorable Analyst Response

Salesforce, Inc. (NYSE:CRM) shares closed at $255.65 on September 15, after a nearly 34% rally in the previous month following a rough start to 2026 that saw the stock tumble as much as 37%. That momentum was fueled by Salesforce's most recent quarterly results, which featured $11.35 billion in revenue, exceeding Wall Street's projections on both the top and bottom lines. Analyst reaction to the Dreamforce announcements was also favorable, with Stifel raising its price target for Salesforce, Inc. (NYSE:CRM) to $300 from $275 while reaffirming a Buy rating, citing six distinct revenue channels laid out by the company for monetizing its new AI stack, including additional core licenses, premium SKU upgrades, Agentforce spending, Data 360, Agent Fabric and Guardian, and APIs, MCPs and related infrastructure.

Story Continues

Institutional Positioning

Institutional posture shifted in similar directions for the two competitors. Salesforce, Inc. (NYSE:CRM) saw hedge fund ownership fall slightly, from 101 in the first quarter to 99 in the second. Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) experienced a greater fall, from 282 funds to 273, though both declines predate the Dreamforce event and are more likely to reflect broader software-sector positioning moves than a direct read on this contest.

How AIforce Takes On Copilot

Salesforce's pitch for AIforce as an open layer that brings Salesforce data, permissions and business logic into Claude, ChatGPT and other AI interfaces could still be an important competitive distinction, particularly for companies that want to use Salesforce context across multiple AI environments. The emphasis on regulated data access and zero data retention in Claudeforce directly addresses enterprise trust problems, which have hampered AI adoption elsewhere.

Conference Hype, Unclear Pricing, and Microsoft's Distribution Juggernaut

However, Salesforce's stock has a documented history of rallying on analyst upgrades and conference announcements before reversing those gains, as seen with earlier JPMorgan and Citi buy calls in 2026, and pricing and adoption uncertainty around Agentforce remain unanswered questions even as new products pile on top of it. Microsoft's competition is also far from theoretical, considering Copilot's distribution advantage via Office and Dynamics 365.

Insider Monkey's Bottom Line

Investors should keep an eye on whether this round of enthusiasm lasts longer than previous Dreamforce-fueled surges, with confirmation likely to come from the next quarterly report, which will show whether Agentforce and now AIforce adoption numbers are translating into the kind of Data and AI revenue growth analysts are projecting with their newly set $300 price targets. Given the remaining uncertainty around how quickly Salesforce can convert AI adoption into meaningful revenue, the more reliable signal for investors will be concrete adoption and revenue-conversion data in upcoming earnings, rather than the announcement itself or the pre-Dreamforce rally that followed Salesforce's latest earnings report.

While we acknowledge the potential of CRM as an investment, we believe certain AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. news.Title: 聯發科率先突破創高，台股量能回升聚焦半導體設備、耗材與光通
news.Content:
【財訊快報／黃啟乙】台股週二突破創新高後，週三指數持續維持強勢，成交量也緩步向1兆元靠攏，顯示市場動能持續增溫。其中，聯發科(2454)率先突破並創下新高，成為近期拉動指數向上突破的重要力量之一。　　展望後續，半導體產業持續擴充，台積電(2330)也不斷推進先進製程，相關設備與耗材需求可望同步受到帶動，盤面上設備、耗材族群近期也持續出現強攻表現。

其中，崇越(5434)股價維持盤堅走勢；探針卡領域則可留意景美(7899)，股價自低檔型態逐步回升，已有展開新一輪行情的跡象。此外，光通訊、矽光子等產業近期也展現向上發展動能，若市場資金持續輪動，相關族群可望成為台股後續攻堅的重要陣容。

news.Title: 滙豐估美聯準會12月再升息 明年利率不變
news.Content:
美國 聯準會 (Fed)的利率政策，一直是各國央行的主要參考指引。聯準會在睽違3年後，在9月重新啟動升息。接下來動向，也引發市場關注。滙豐銀行今天(23日)舉行2026年第四季投資展望，認為以美國經濟成長和通膨預期來看，預估聯準會12月會再升息1碼，明年利率則會保持不變。

針對市場高度關切聯準會利率決策，滙豐私人銀行及財富管理北亞首席投資總監 何偉華 表示，雖然美國基準利率已來到相對高檔，但美國核心通膨表現依然頑強，根據最新總體經濟模型推估，美國核心通膨可能要一路延續至2028年，才有機會實質降至聯準會設定的2%政策目標。

何偉華也指出，聯準會在9月的官方報告中，已同步調高今年與明年的美國經濟成長率(GDP)預測。他分析，在「經濟基本面出乎意料強勁」與「通膨高檔」的雙重背景下，聯準會有相當大的壓力必須透過升息來抑制經濟過熱。因此，12月再加碼升息1碼幾乎已成定局。

何偉華也進一步表示，若今年年底前聯準會升息2碼，屆時基準利率將推升至4%，比目前的通膨率還要高，明年聯準會就會「按兵不動」，持續觀察在高利率下的美國國內通膨情勢。何偉華說：『(原音)最主要原因就是在能源方面，我們剛才說對美國的通膨影響比較小。第二就是美國升息兩碼之後，它的利率也明顯比通膨高，所以利率的水平對通膨控制也要一定的力度。』

若聯準會在今年兩度升息，是否會對股債市帶來重新估值的風險？何偉華認為，美國企業目前的盈利增長預期依然維持在15%至20%的高水準，尤其在AI算力與資料中心的基礎建設資本支出持續擴大下，科技股的基本面依舊強韌。目前美股本益比約在18至19倍，屬於過去5年的歷史合理區間，因此年底若再升息1碼，對美股整體估值的實質衝擊相當有限。 (編輯:柳向華)

news.Title: 費半6連紅、Meta神助攻！大戶抱1億爽賺2,200萬「大盤4萬8、散戶手上剩1萬8？」買到這些股票恐淪長假前最慘替死鬼
news.Content:
台股多頭氣勢如虹！受到美股科技股續創新高、Meta全新AI助理爆紅，以及台灣本土基本面外銷訂單連19紅等三大核心利多點火，台股今（23）日開盤後展現強勁漲勢。大盤在電子權值股與科技晶片股群起攻之下，盤中一度狂飆逾500點，強勢叩關48,000點歷史整數大關，再度刷新台股新紀錄。然而，盤面呈現極端的兩極化走勢，也引發市場法人與網路社群的激烈辯論。

國際多頭三重奏 費半六連紅奠定外資買盤

從國際盤勢來看，與台股連動性極高的費城半導體指數昨日上漲2.06％，已寫下連續六個交易日收紅的強勢紀錄。由於美國債券殖利率止穩，加上中東地緣政治傳出荷莫茲海峽（Strait of Hormuz）可能開放的消息，國際油價進一步跌破百元大關，大幅舒緩市場對通膨的擔憂，吸引全球資金持續回流科技成長股；指標股台積電ADR上揚1.54％，帶動台指期夜盤先一步大漲272點，為今日台股現貨開盤奠定了強大的外資買盤基礎。

除了美股費半大漲，科技巨頭Meta推出的全新AI助理「Muse」在全球人氣爆棚，更被彭博等主流財經媒體預言可能成為AI領域的殺手級應用。這股熱潮不僅刺激Meta股價飆漲，更直接點燃了台灣AI供應鏈的戰火；資金在現貨市場開盤後，蜂擁圍繞在半導體、先進裝測、記憶體及ABF載板等相關題材進行拉抬。

ABF、記憶體全面引爆 非電族群台泥一枝獨秀

觀察今日盤面強勢族群，ABF載板族群受惠於AI晶片與先進封裝需求極度吃緊，市場傳出第四季報價將持續調漲，成為最吸金的焦點。景碩（3189）開盤後迅速攻上漲停，多方力道強勁；欣興（3037）與南電（8046）同樣受到族群共振效應帶動，亮燈漲停或大漲。

記憶體族群則因美股記憶體大廠美光與SanDisk股價飆漲逾5％，帶動台廠跌深強彈。南亞科（2408）帶量強勢開高大漲逾5％，股價一舉重回短多格局；華邦電（2344）、南茂（8150）分別大漲3％至4％以上，南茂盤中更一度觸及漲停；高價記憶體模組與IC設計股群聯（8299）與宜鼎（5289）漲幅也均超過4％。

此外，權王台積電（2330）早盤大漲20元至2,480元，扮演大盤衝鋒的核心支柱；友達（2409）傳出與台積電、英特爾擴大跨入先進封裝領域，股價展現強勁續航力；高價矽智財與台積電供應鏈的創意（3443）、力旺（3529）也獲資金青睞。非電子股方面，台泥（1101）臨時董事會通過將收購烏克蘭第二大水泥建材公司IFCEM，推進東歐市場布局，利多激勵股價盤中飆漲逾6％，成為傳產亮點。

打炒房陰影重擊營建 金融熄火、長假調節賣壓湧現

相對於電子的火熱，營建與金融族群則淪為弱勢重災區。營建族群受到先前央行打炒房政策的長線陰影壓抑，加上盤面資金高度被電子股吸走，整體營建指數盤中重挫逾2％，多檔指標型營建股皆開高走低逆勢下殺；金融族群也因美債殖利率曲線變動壓抑了銀行股獲利預期，美股大型金融股高位轉弱，蔓延至台股導致金融股今日普遍熄火。另適逢中秋與教師節長假將至，部分高位階或先前漲多的中小型股面臨長假調節賣壓，如世紀*（9958）、光鋐（4916）、豪勉（6218）等中小型股在盤中不幸打入跌停，惠特（6706）、高僑（6234）則因高檔獲利了結賣壓湧現，重挫8％以上。

名師大咖堅定喊「五萬點」 專家示警：防爆量假突破

針對今日驚天漲勢，投顧法人與市場分析師看法相對樂觀，但也維持居高思危的謹慎。摩爾投顧投資長郭哲榮堅定看好長線「5萬點」行情，並大方透露自己砸下1億元買進的台灣元大50（0050）至今累計獲利突破2,200萬元，依然一股不賣；不過，也提醒投資人，面對高檔行情切勿亂追，操作應採取「低基期、右側交易」原則，等個股止跌重新轉強時再順勢布局，例如關注智原等ASIC、矽智財個股。

華南投顧董事長呂仁傑則提出警示看法，指出大盤雖然創高，但多數個股熱度其實已降溫，近期指數與個股表現明顯分歧。他提醒今天操作必須防範高檔震盪及開高走低的風

news.Title: 國家隊近3日砸18億撿緯創！聯發科反遭倒41億 友達、景碩漲停也被賣
news.Content:
台股近日持續高檔震盪，八大官股銀行資金也開始換邊布局。統計18、21、22日共3個交易日，官股前十大買超金額合計約78.31億元，前十大賣超則達210.16億元，賣超金額約為買超2.7倍；其中緯創(3231)獲買超近18億元居冠，聯發科(2454)則遭調節逾41億元，形成鮮明對比。

22日台股一度衝上48,601.53點歷史新高，終場收47,800.17點，同創收盤新高，但高低點震盪達801點，長假前獲利了結賣壓也開始浮現。

緯創越跌越買 藥華藥居第2

近3日官股買超冠軍為緯創，共買超9,736張、金額17.96億元。緯創22日下跌3.22%至180.5元，成交量放大至6.78萬張；當天外資甚至反手大賣緯創約3萬張，官股與外資操作方向明顯分歧。

第2名則是藥華藥(6446)，獲買超12.53億元；藥華藥自行研發的Ropeg今年已先後取得台灣、日本及美國原發性血小板過多症（ET）藥證，8月營收26.17億元、年增105.43%。

買超榜第3~5名依序為大華優利高填息30(00918)、南亞(1303)及智邦(2345)，買超金額分別約9.39億、6.57億及5.93億元。另有穎崴(6515)、金像電(2368)、玉晶光(3406)、雙鴻(3324)、大立光(3008)擠進前十。

對於緯創後勢，啟發投顧分析師郭憲政較為保留並指出，緯創上半年EPS為7.78元，股價估值看來不高，但今年8月盤中206元高點及200元關卡仍構成壓力；他認為，AI伺服器代工股最強的一段漲勢可能已過，短線轉強仍須觀察股價能否突破並站穩200元。

聯發科創高卻遭倒41億 友達漲停也被賣

賣超榜方面，官股操作反而集中近期強勢股。近3日官股賣超聯發科852張、金額高達41.10億元居冠；聯發科22日盤中一度衝上5,480元歷史高點，終場仍大漲3.39%收5,180元。市場近期聚焦其AI與高階運算題材。

資深分析師蔡明翰近日表示，市場已提前反映聯發科的後續獲利成長，並指出近期強勢有其預期基礎；他同時提醒，股價走高後估值已不便宜，短線操作風險升高。

台積電(2330)遭賣超27.48億元居第2，日月光投控(3711)24.85億元第3；後續依序為友達(2409)、台達電(2308)、景碩(3189)、京元電子(2449)、瑞昱(2379)、聯電(2303)及台光電(2383)。

其中反差最大的友達近3日遭官股賣超6.35萬張、約21.88億元，但22日卻以36.65元漲停作收，爆出逾115萬張大量。友達連續兩個交易日漲停，近期市場題材集中於先進封裝、CPO及資產活化，股價也部分反映與台積電、英特爾的合作傳聞。

景碩同樣遭官股調節20.74億元，22日卻漲停收909元；雙鴻則成為少數「股價強、官股也買」個股，近3日獲買超4.06億元，22日上漲5.26%至1,600元，盤中最高觸及1,630元歷史新高，市場持續反映AI伺服器水冷散熱需求。

news.Title: SK Hynix Is Eyeing Intel’s (INTC) Ohio Site. Why Micron (MU) Should Pay Attention
news.Content:
SK Hynix is exploring something it has never done before: manufacturing memory chips in the United States.

Reuters reported on September 16 that the Korean memory giant is discussing several possibilities with Intel Corporation (NASDAQ: INTC ), including leasing part of Intel's long-delayed Ohio complex or forming a venture involving Intel and large cloud customers. SK Hynix said no specific plan has been finalized.

For Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ: MU ), the talks matter because one of its strongest strategic advantages is being the major U.S.-based memory producer while AI has made DRAM and HBM increasingly scarce.

SK Hynix Could Give Intel Another Path for Its Delayed Ohio Site

Intel has committed enormous capital to Ohio, with the broader project potentially reaching around $100 billion over time. Delays have pushed planned production into the next decade. A tenant or joint-venture partner could therefore help Intel share the financial burden of developing the Ohio site rather than relying entirely on its own foundry demand to justify the buildout.

That is the bull case. The bear case is that exploratory talks are a long way from revenue. Bringing advanced Korean memory production to the U.S. could face cost problems, technology-transfer restrictions and objections from Seoul. Intel still needs its core manufacturing roadmap to work.

Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) sits on the other side of the equation. AI demand has pushed memory pricing and availability into a strong cycle, and Micron is already pursuing a large U.S. manufacturing expansion. More domestic manufacturing incentives and customer interest in secure supply support that plan.

A successful SK Hynix move could eventually erode part of Micron's U.S.-supply differentiation. U.S. cloud companies would gain another potential domestic supplier, while additional long-term memory capacity could eventually loosen the market that currently supports exceptional pricing.

Hedge funds loaded up on both chipmakers

Insider Monkey tracked 138 hedge funds holding Intel in Q2, up sharply from 112 in Q1. AQR Capital Management held roughly 10.7 million shares after trimming its stake about 7%. Micron's count rose to 184 funds from 154, one of the stronger quarter-over-quarter increases among large semiconductor names. Coatue Management expanded its MU stake dramatically during the quarter.

Intel had about 152.2 million shares sold short as of August 31, roughly 3% of public float and 1.7 days to cover.

The talks do not rescue Intel's foundry strategy or weaken Micron overnight. They do show what AI scarcity is doing to the supply chain. Memory manufacturing is becoming strategic enough that SK Hynix is considering putting advanced capacity on American soil, and Intel's delayed Ohio project suddenly gives it a potentially valuable asset to negotiate with.

Story Continues

news.Title: Pat Gelsinger Just Backed a $100 Million Challenge to Nvidia’s AI Networking Moat. AMD Could Benefit
news.Content:
Former Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger is backing a startup that thinks AI's next bottleneck is not the accelerator. It is everything waiting for data to arrive.

Delos Data announced on September 15 that it raised more than $100 million to develop networking chips and software for increasingly heterogeneous AI data centers. Playground Global, where Gelsinger is a general partner, joined the round. Reuters reported that Delos is designing the network to work across different types of compute hardware rather than assuming every accelerator comes from NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ: NVDA ).

That makes Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMD ) an important read-through even though AMD is not an investor in Delos.

For illustration purposes only. Photo by Brett Sayles on Pexels

Open networking attacks the strongest part of Nvidia's stack

Nvidia does not dominate AI simply because its GPUs are fast. NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA) sells a tightly integrated system of accelerators, networking, interconnects and software. That makes large clusters easier to deploy and gives customers fewer reasons to mix architectures.

Delos is betting the market becomes less uniform as inference expands. Its pitch is that a data center should be able to connect whatever mix of accelerators makes economic sense. Gelsinger described idle compute waiting for data as a major waste of both money and energy.

If that architecture works, AMD benefits indirectly. Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMD) has been improving Instinct accelerator performance and winning AI deployments, but every friction point involved in mixing AMD hardware with another vendor's ecosystem protects Nvidia. Hardware-agnostic networking could lower that friction.

The counterargument is brutal: Nvidia already has scale, mature software and networking products customers know work. A startup with $100 million of financing is attacking an incumbent that spends billions on research and sells the full rack. Delos also has to prove its claimed performance improvements in commercial deployments.

Hedge funds increased exposure to both incumbents

Insider Monkey tracked 285 hedge funds holding Nvidia in Q2, up from 275 in Q1. Arrowstreet Capital raised its position 10% to roughly 34.7 million shares. AMD's holder count climbed to 164 from 134, while Marshall Wace held approximately 3.9 million shares after increasing its stake modestly.

AMD had about 41.7 million shares sold short as of August 31, equal to roughly 2.6% of float and 2.5 days to cover.

Story Continues

Delos does not have to replace Nvidia networking to matter. It only has to make mixed AI clusters easier to build. Nvidia's moat is strongest when customers buy the entire system together. Anything that makes the pieces more interchangeable gives AMD and every other accelerator challenger a slightly wider door.

While we acknowledge the potential of NVDA and AMD as investments, we believe certain other AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. news.Title: Nvidia Stock Could Surge by 2028: Here's How Beginners Can Get In Now According to Motley Fool's Price Estimates
news.Content:
Even if you're a total novice to the stock market, you've probably heard of Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA).

Nvidia is now the most valuable company in the world, worth more than $5 trillion. Its chips have formed the backbone of the AI revolution, and the top AI labs and cloud computing platforms rely on them to make AI applications run.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 15x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

If you were fortunate enough to buy Nvidia a decade ago and hold it, you would have made a huge return as the stock is up more than 14,000% during that time. That means a $1,000 investment in Nvidia would now be worth more than $14,000.

The stock won't do that again over the next decade, but it still looks poised to soar by 2028. Here's how I see it.

Nvidia is still cheap

There's a lot of jargon in investing, but one of the most important concepts that beginning investors can learn is the price-to-earnings ratio , or P/E ratio. This is a company's price per share divided by its earnings per share.

Newbie investors often think that a stock's share price determines whether it is cheap or not. For instance, a $10 stock would be cheap and a $500 stock would be expensive, but the share price alone isn't really meaningful.

Owning a share of a stock is a claim on its earnings, so what really matters is how much earnings you get relative to the price of the stock. That's the P/E ratio. The lower it is, the cheaper the stock.

Nvidia now trades at a P/E of 29, which is slightly higher than the S&P 500's P/E ratio of 25. The S&P 500 , an index that holds 500 of the biggest U.S. stocks, is generally seen as the market average. According to the numbers above, Nvidia is a bit more expensive than the S&P 500. However, the P/E ratio is backward-looking, and stocks are priced based on future earnings or cash flows.

Because of its central position in the AI boom, Nvidia is growing much faster than the S&P 500. Wall Street expects the company to grow revenue by 91% this year and 66% next year. For fiscal 2028, which ends in January of that year, Nvidia is expected to have earnings per share of $15.68.

Based on that forecast, the stock trades at 14.6x next year's earnings. or a forward P/E of 14.6. If Nvidia maintains its current P/E ratio and hits that EPS forecast, the stock would double in less than a year and a half.

Story Continues

How to buy Nvidia stock

If you're new to investing and you want to buy Nvidia stock, you'll first need a brokerage account if you don't already have one. You can open one up with a platform like Robinhood , Interactive Brokers , E*TRADE from Morgan Stanley , or Charles Schwab . There are a lot of options for brokers.

Nvidia is currently trading around $228 a share, so you'll need that much to buy one share. However, many brokerages now offer fractional share purchasing, meaning you can buy a fraction of a share of Nvidia, allowing you to get ownership for less than the price of a share. Once you have an account, you'll need to search for the stock using the ticker, NVDA, and then choose an order type. Using a market order will execute the trade immediately and is the easiest way to buy a heavily traded stock like Nvidia. If you want to set a maximum price you're willing to pay, you can use a limit order.

Keep in mind that while Nvidia's future looks promising and the numbers favor continued gains in the stock, there is always risk in stock investing. There is no guarantee that the stock will go up between now and 2028. With any investment, it's a good idea to keep a long-term view and continue to follow the stock. Don't just buy and forget. If things change, you may want to sell.

Still, I think the odds are in your favor. As long as the AI boom continues over the next two years, Nvidia looks well-positioned to be a winner.

news.Title: Lumentum Jumped Nearly 10% While Corning Barely Moved. Is the AI Optics Trade Splitting Apart?
news.Content:
When AI stocks rebounded last week, optical networking companies did not rebound equally.

Lumentum Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: LITE ) jumped nearly 10% in Wednesday trading and led the S&P 500, while Coherent rose 6.9%. Corning Incorporated (NYSE: GLW ) managed only a 0.4% gain and remained down sharply for the week.

All three sit inside the same broad AI-connectivity buildout. The divergence suggests investors are beginning to distinguish between different pieces of that infrastructure rather than buying every optics name together.

Photo from Lumentum Holdings website

Lumentum offers concentrated exposure to the bandwidth problem

AI clusters increasingly need optical connections as more accelerators communicate across larger physical distances. That drives demand for high-speed transceivers, lasers and other photonic components.

For Lumentum Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ:LITE), concentrated exposure is both the attraction and the risk. Strong hyperscaler spending can create powerful operating leverage as faster generations of optical links ramp. The same concentration can produce violent corrections when investors question the pace of AI spending or customer deployments.

Corning Incorporated (NYSE:GLW) has a broader business and participates through optical fiber and connectivity infrastructure. The company benefits as hyperscalers build new campuses and connect larger networks, but that exposure is less directly tied to the highest-value transceiver components.

Corning also introduced a fresh complication. A September filing established an equity distribution agreement allowing the company to sell up to $2 billion of stock through Goldman Sachs. That gives Corning capital flexibility for large projects, but potential issuance creates dilution at a moment when investors are already scrutinizing the cost of AI infrastructure expansion.

Professional investors also split on the two names

Insider Monkey's database showed Lumentum ownership falling to 111 hedge funds in Q2 from 123 in Q1. Arrowstreet Capital nevertheless increased its position sharply during the quarter. Corning moved the other way, rising to 99 hedge-fund holders from 91, while Tairen Capital increased its GLW position by roughly 9%.

Lumentum's August 31 short interest stood at about 7.12 million shares, nearly 8% of public float, with approximately 1.7 days to cover. That makes positioning meaningfully heavier than in many large-cap AI infrastructure names.

The takeaway from the rebound is not that Lumentum won and Corning lost. Their economics are different. Lumentum offers more concentrated exposure to high-speed optical components, while Corning offers broader exposure to the fiber-heavy physical buildout underneath them. When the AI trade becomes selective, that distinction suddenly matters.

news.Title: 標普500逼近新高、個股卻頻創新低 美股浮現1999年式罕見背離 岡拉克怎麼操作？
news.Content:
美股主要指數近期持續逼近歷史高點，但指數表面強勢之下，個股表現卻出現罕見分化。9月21日交易中，標普500指數上漲1.49%, 收在7,764.70點，距離歷史高點不到1%, 同日那斯達克綜合指數上漲約2%, 創下收盤新高。然而，標普500成分股中卻有30檔股票觸及52週新低, 僅7檔創下52週新高，形成指數上漲與市場廣度惡化並存的異常格局。

更值得注意的是，若將觀察區間從52週擴大至60日及120日，市場內部弱勢程度同樣明顯。最新統計顯示，標普500成分股中，近3個交易日創60日新低的股票達99檔，創60日新高的僅28檔；創120日新低的股票達77檔，創120日新高的僅22檔。換言之，即使指數已經逼近歷史高點，個股層面的下跌壓力仍然廣泛存在。

這種現象被市場策略師視為「市場廣度」與指數走勢之間的重大背離。9月21日的特殊之處並不只是新低股票多於新高股票，而是標普500單日上漲至少1%, 同時距離歷史高點不到1%, 卻仍出現新低股多於新高股的組合。SentimenTrader創辦人、NextGen News顧問Jason Goepfert指出，往前追溯近百年，符合這組條件的前一次案例是1999年12月21日, 更早則是1929年7月23日。

不過，這項歷史比較本身並不代表市場即將重演1929年或1999年的走勢。兩個歷史案例距離後續市場重大轉折都有數月時間，而且樣本極少，因此更適合作為市場廣度異常的歷史參照，而非單獨用來判斷後市方向。

目前的另一個警訊是指數內部的參與程度。近期資料顯示，標普500成分股中，站在50日移動平均線之上的股票比例不到30%, 顯示推動指數上漲的股票數量相對有限。換言之，標普500指數仍然具有韌性，但指數上漲並未同步擴散至大部分成分股。

從產業結構來看，近期漲勢主要集中在資訊科技、通訊服務及非必需消費品等板塊。其中資訊科技類股距離52週高點不到1%, 但通訊服務及非必需消費品仍分別落後各自高點約4%及7%。B. Riley Financial (RILY-US)旗下B. Riley Wealth首席市場策略師Art Hogan表示，市場領漲板塊目前正努力抵抗板塊輪動帶來的壓力，而已經遭到拋售的股票，由於距離前低較近，因此形成新低的難度反而較低。

Hogan同時指出，如果中東局勢持續影響市場情緒，類似的市場廣度分化可能在未來幾個月間零星出現。他認為，若戰事持續、能源價格維持高位, 同時聯準會需要維持偏緊縮的利率政策, 市場要再創歷史新高將面臨更大阻力。近期市場也持續受到中東局勢、油價及利率預期牽動。9月22日交易中，標普500小幅走弱, 道瓊工業指數下跌逾290點, 金融股成為主要拖累，而市場仍關注油價接近每桶100美元所帶來的通膨壓力。

市場情緒同樣出現變化。不過，原稿所稱高盛情緒指標最新降至負0.9需要加以釐清。高盛研究資料顯示，美國市場情緒指標曾在3月底降至負0.9, 隨後回升至正0.8, 因此負0.9並非目前最新讀數。

在市場廣度出現異常之際, DoubleLine Capital創辦人兼執行長傑佛瑞・岡拉克(Jeffrey Gundlach)則進一步將焦點放在人工智慧交易。他以2007年美國房地產泡沫判斷而受到市場關注，近期表示自己正在盡可能降低投資組合對AI交易的曝險，並直言「我只想退出」。不過，岡拉克也強調，他並非全面拋售股票，也沒有放空AI相關股票，而是希望遠離他認為可能承受最大損失的市場區域。

岡拉克認為，AI投資敘事已經從「一切都很美好」的階段轉向投資人開始重新檢視風險。他指出，市場過去對AI能力及商業前景抱持高度樂觀態度，但如今開始出現對技術能力、資本支出及企業融資需求的疑問。岡拉克並表示，AI交易何時真正出現崩跌，他自己也無法確定，但認為市場已經接近需要更加謹慎看待的階段。

他尤其關注AI相關企業快速增加的資本需求及信用市場變化，認為企業為了AI基礎建設而大量借貸，可能在利率或資金成本上升時放大金融市場風險。此外，他也提到SpaceX潛在市場規模的龐大估值。市場報導指出，馬斯克曾將相關潛在市場規模估計為28.5兆美元。岡拉克認為，如果少數企業最終占據如此龐大的AI市場，市場利益不可能平均分配，因此AI競賽中勢必會出現失敗者。

news.Title: 台積電最強「親兒子」超狂！外資喊1.2萬目標價：獲利可望翻8倍
news.Content:
台股多頭氣勢升溫，高價IC設計族群表現亮眼，聯發科昨一度衝上5480元，刷新歷史天價；創意同樣強勢，今股價攻上8540元，再創新高，短線漲幅突破4成。市場買盤受到外資最新報告激勵，Aletheia Capital首度將創意納入研究，並給予「買進」評等，目標價更喊至12000元，遠高於目前股價，帶動市場追價買盤湧入，推升股價強勢走高。

創意為台積電轉投資公司，隨著ASIC業務大好，可說是台積電最強的「親兒子」。創意最近更獲外資Aletheia Capital首度納入研究，直接給予「買進」評等，目標價喊到驚人的12000元。

Aletheia Capital指出，隨著代理型AI工作負載快速增加，加上全球算力成本持續攀升，Google、微軟等雲端服務供應商（CSP）與AI實驗室正加速投入自研ASIC，創意可望成為這波趨勢的重要受惠者。其優勢不僅來自完整的矽智財（IP）組合，也包括先進封裝、統包服務，以及與台積電設計建置服務（DTP）部門的緊密合作。

報告進一步指出，創意目前產品線已從Google、微軟的自研CPU，逐步拓展至多家CSP客製化ASIC，預期2027年N3、N5製程晶圓分配量將增加約5倍，反映委託設計（NRE）案轉化為量產營收的能力持續提升。

在財務表現方面，外資預估創意2026年營收將翻倍，2027年更可能大幅成長4倍，2028年再增加約50%；受惠營運槓桿效益，2026至2028年EPS合計可望成長約8倍。

報告預估創意2026年EPS達52.75元、年增87.52%，2027年進一步攀升至123.46元、年增134%，遠高於目前市場預期。

隨全球AI ASIC市場持續擴張，創意能否將龐大的AI需求進一步轉化為實際營收與獲利，將成為市場接下來追蹤的關鍵。報告同時提醒，市場需求變化與團隊執行力仍是主要風險。

news.Title: 【台股盤中】電子水泥強勢　台股盤中揚升541點攀高至48341點
news.Content:
（中央社記者張建中台北2026年9月23日電）台股今天開高走高，加權指數重登48000點關卡之上，早盤上攻48341.56點，上揚541.39點；不過，在長假效應影響下，盤中漲勢收斂，以水泥和電子類股表現相對強勢。

至10時42分，台股加權指數為48130.83點，上漲330.66點，成交值新台幣5195億元。

台泥 (1101) 臨時董事會通過授權旗下荷蘭子公司，以不超過7.5億歐元企業價值，推進收購烏克蘭第2大水泥建材公司IFCEM等公司100%股權，進一步布局東歐市場。台泥今天股價表現強勁，盤中上漲至26.1元，漲幅達6.31%，推升水泥類股指數大漲3.85%。

其餘傳統產業股漲跌互見，紡織、橡膠類股指數上漲，塑膠、玻璃和機電類股指數下挫逾1%，營建類股指數下跌逾2%，表現相對疲弱。

電子股方面，台積電美國存託憑證（ADR）上漲1.54%，台積電 (2330) 今天股價隨著走強，盤中一度達到2505元，上漲45元，市值回升至64.96兆元，貢獻大盤約357點。

其餘電子權值股鴻海 (2317) 、日月光投控 (3711) 、台光電 (2383) 、欣興 (3037) 及高價股健策 (3653) 、奇鋐 (3017) 、旺矽 (6223) 、穎崴 (6515) 也紛紛走高，推升整體電子類股指數上漲逾1.4%。（編輯：張良知）

news.Title: 台股創新高爆「虛胖」危機！個股賠慘 散戶小心2大衝擊
news.Content:
台股昨（22日）創下48601.53點歷史新高，但上市櫃有超過千檔收跌，顯示多數個股仍無法跟上大盤，形成「虛胖」結構，尤其最大權值股台積電並未突破2535元歷史新高，成為最大警訊，另有專家提醒，台股需要小心假突破、真拉回的風險。

大盤漲瘋、個股趴地 散戶其實沒賺？

台股昨日盤中一度大漲將近900點，但尾盤漲勢快速收斂，最終僅小漲81點，且千金股走勢嚴重分歧，僅聯發科、創意、信驊等高價股噴出，權值股也僅有富邦金、聯發科及南亞等個股跟隨台股創新高。

嚴重分化的狀況顯示市場缺乏廣度，如果權值股熄火或出現獲利了結賣壓，缺乏其他接棒族群，大盤極易出現陡峭的大拉回。知名分析師蔡明翰於《鈔錢部署》節目中表示，投資人必須小心假突破、真拉回的風險。

台股浮現危機 散戶小心這件事

蔡明翰認為，後市觀察指標在於美國費城半導體指數的狀況，如果費城半導體指數未能轉強，台股的表現也會受到壓抑，且台股在高點時也要提高警覺心，防範拉回風險。

另外，蔡明翰認為美債殖利率不是牽動股市發展的最重要原因，過往疫情與歐債危機造成股市下跌時，殖利率往往是在低檔徘徊，且只要利率沒有出現快速升息的極端狀況，股市就能避免重大打擊。

從過往狀況來看，當個股與大盤的背離狀況達到極致時，通常會出現三種狀況，其中以撐盤權值股補跌，使大盤出現修正的機率最高，另有可能出現橫盤整理，資金向低基期族群流動，進而出現補漲，或者漲多後震盪，個股劇烈洗盤。

news.Title: 3 Stocks to Buy and Hold Even if There's a Stock Market Sell-Off This Fall
news.Content:
Stock markets sell off. That's part of investing, and even great companies can get caught in the drop. But some businesses are built to take a hit and keep moving, especially when they sell things people need or offer a clear reason to keep spending with them.

The following three companies have the scale, brands, and everyday demand that can help cushion their stocks when the market gets shaky , whether it's this fall or next year or three years from now. A sell-off could still knock these shares down for a while, but I would expect the damage to be more of a dip than a long-term breakdown.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

1. Costco

Costco Wholesale (NASDAQ: COST) keeps leaning into its simple promise : Pay a membership fee; get everyday value. This year, the company is opening roughly two dozen net new warehouses, relocating some older clubs into larger formats, and investing billions in new buildings, depots, and remodels. In a shaky market, that matters because Costco's model tends to pull in both budget‑conscious families and higher‑income shoppers who still want a deal.

Also, its business is built around essentials, so demand can hold up even when consumers pull back elsewhere. Look at COVID times, when its same-store sales rose 7.7% even during fiscal 2020. Its huge scale also gives it purchasing power and a cost advantage that can help it remain competitive when shoppers become more price-conscious.

2. Walmart

Walmart (NASDAQ: WMT) is using automation and digital tools to make its "everyday low price" promise more durable. In its latest results and at a consumer conference, management highlighted strong revenue growth, a 26% jump in enterprise e‑commerce sales, and delivery speeds that now fulfill many orders in under three hours.

Behind that, roughly half of U.S. e‑commerce fulfillment volume and more than 60% of store freight already move through automated distribution centers, and membership, marketplace, and advertising now contribute around one‑third of operating income.

Perhaps Walmart's biggest strength is its sheer scale, giving it a huge customer base and a powerful position in everyday retail. Its grocery business and broad store network also provide a steady stream of repeat shoppers, even as consumers cut back. The company is also building higher-margin businesses like online advertising, which could provide another source of profit growth over time.

Story Continues

Walmart is too popular and too big to really be hit long-term by a market sell-off or recession. The company has too many customers.

3. Unilever

Unilever (NYSE: UL) has spent the past two years simplifying itself into a more focused home, beauty, and personal-care business. In 2026, management is combining its foods business with McCormick to create a separate flavor group, while positioning the remaining company as a roughly $44.7 billion pure play in home and personal care with 62% of revenue from faster‑growing emerging markets.

First‑half results showed volume‑led sales growth of 4.8%, with its Power Brands delivering 6% underlying sales growth and home care growing more than 7%, which is exactly the kind of broad, staple‑heavy demand investors want when the macro backdrop feels fragile. Unilever is still returning cash through dividends and share buybacks while acquiring strong brands in areas such as supplements and premium personal care.

If markets get jumpy, people will still wash clothes, brush their teeth, and buy shampoo, and Unilever's portfolio reshaping will ensure more of that spending flows through its labels.

news.Title: 重壓0050爽賺2千萬！ 郭哲榮喊「絕不出清」：台股上看10萬點
news.Content:
台股近日多頭氣勢強勁，22日再度創新高來到48601點。摩爾投顧投資長郭哲榮日前曾在7月底重挫時，重壓1億元搶進元大台灣50（0050），不到兩個月帳面獲利逼近2000萬元，他表示「獲利絕不出清」，並認為台股3年內上看10萬點。

重壓0050一億報酬率近20%

郭哲榮曾在今年7月29日、台股指數跌破4萬點時，豪砸1億元買進1100張0050，每股均價約93元；後續台股強力反彈，截至9月22日帳面獲利更衝上1987萬元、報酬率近20%。

櫃買指數具補漲空間

針對大盤創高後遇到獲利賣壓，郭哲榮分析，主因在於美股費城半導體、那斯達克指數尚未同步創新高，而台股暫時領先，部分資金選擇先行獲利了結。不過，雖已創新高，但櫃買（OTC）距離前高尚有明顯差距，這個「位階差」預示著中小型股可能迎來補漲行情，是資金下一步輪動的重要觀察指標。

看好台股3年上10萬點

郭哲榮預言，台股3年內有機會挑戰10萬點，其3大核心支撐分別為：

一、國際資金面趨穩

美國10年期公債殖利率自高位回落，加上地緣政治風險降低，國際油價下滑，全球緊縮壓力減輕，提供台股強大支撐。

二、AI產業強勁動能

Meta推出的AI產品Muse以雲端代理模式熱銷，iOS下載量達180萬次，遠超過ChatGPT初期成績，間接帶動晶片（ASIC）及矽智財（IP）等硬體需求，助攻台廠業績。

三、低基期與右側交易點燃輪動

如聯發科（2454）盤中飆上新高，低基期個股智原（3035）、精材（3374）、環球晶（6488）等「右側交易」標的陸續浮現，帶動盤面新一輪攻勢。

「右側交易」擁抱多頭趨勢

郭哲榮提醒，行情創高時更宜以「右側交易」取代悲觀猜底的左側投資思維，待趨勢明朗後進場，順勢布局AI主軸、低基期輪動標的，把握多頭紅利。

（封面圖／翻攝自郭哲榮YT）

news.Title: Bank of America backs Meta stock after Muse surprise

The app can browse websites, organize email, and complete multi-step tasks with limited user intervention, pushing Meta beyond chatbots toward a practical digital agent. Early adoption has given the bull case momentum, while the strong initial numbers add weight to the argument that Meta could turn billions in AI infrastructure spending into a differentiated consumer ...

news.Title: 雍智科技Q3營收拚新高 Q4續揚可期
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-09-23 09:57:16 王怡茹 發佈

半導體測試介面廠雍智科技(6683)自結2026年8月營收2.33億元，月增1.36%、年增25.74%，稅前淨利4,900萬元、年減11%，稅後淨利3,500萬元、年減22%，EPS 1.3元。展望後市，法人表示，受惠AI、HPC及網通相關測試介面訂單挹注，預期第三季營收再創單季新高，第四季動能進一步向上。

雍智科技第一大客戶為聯發科(2454)，雙方長期在網通、手機、PC及車用等測試介面合作，2021年再結盟日系夥伴切入5G手機AP供應鏈，2025年跨入AI PC相關測試介面。針對新一代TPU部分，據悉，近期雍智科技已順利通過大客戶驗證，惟因採購策略有變數，有可能由晶圓廠拿下多數訂單配額，公司取得部分訂單，後續仍需觀察。

值得注意的是，雍智8月營收改寫歷史單月新高，惟獲利較去年同期下滑。法人分析，公司近年成長較快的前段晶圓探針卡業務，探針頭部分需由外部合作夥伴供應，相較既有測試介面產品成本較高，加上新產品仍需經歷學習曲線，對毛利率形成壓力，加上匯率因素干擾，致使8月獲利不如期。

不過，法人看好，後續隨經濟規模擴大、生產效率提升及產品組合優化，雍智科技相關成本結構有望逐步改善，今年毛利率、獲利仍將優於去年。以明年成長動能來看，在AI、HPC浪潮下，公司仍占據有利位置，全年營運表現是否能進一步跳升，則需觀察TPU專案進度、生產效率提升狀況。

news.Title: 台股衝史高「市值全球第4大」！法人看旺伺服器、載板、電源、散熱　還有這些族群值得留意
news.Content:
[ FTNN新聞網 ]財經中心／綜合報導

在美國科技股走揚的激勵下，台股於昨（22）日連袂走揚，昨早盤在市值龍頭股領漲下，大漲882.69點來到48601.53點，改寫盤中新高，爾後雖遭獲利調節賣壓，終場漲幅收斂至81.33點，最終收在47800.17點也是寫下收盤新高紀錄。市場法人表示，隨台股收復先前回檔修正的失土，根據MarketCapWatch網站所公布之最新全球主要股市市值排名，台股市值已躍居全球第四大，而想跟隨台股成長行情，能機動調整持股的主動市值ETF可說是最為便利的工具，既享大型龍頭股的底氣，也能把握重點趨勢/題材股的成長行情。

群益投信主動式台股ETF研究團隊表示，近年來台股市值前50大跟隨產業發展與當時市況而持續洗牌，回顧2020-2022年因新冠疫情影響而令面板、載板、航運類股備受市場關注，爾後在AI科技於全球掀起浪潮下，2023至2024年AI基建題材火熱，也讓伺服器、ASIC、散熱等重點個股市值躍進，進入2025年後至今，隨AI需求擴散，PCB、記憶體、測試成為資金布局重點，其2025年更是近十年市值前50大企業替換高峰。正因主流產業更替，建議投資人可透過主動市值ETF來掌握，以跟隨市場結構動態調整，網羅當代核心企業，掌握台股成長和新動能。

主動群益核心50 (00415A)經理人許育誌表示，先前受中東局勢不穩與國際股市去槓桿的影響，台股一度拉回修正，不過隨著不確定性逐一解除、聯準會如期升息之利空淡化，以及台灣央行不跟進升息緩解國內資金成本上漲壓力，在AI科技基本面強勁與第四季電子消費旺季等利多支持下，有助吸引資金回流布局市值龍頭股與重點AI趨勢股，後市表現值得關注，包括AI伺服器、PCB/ABF、測試介面、半導體設備、電源與散熱等類股表現值得留意。

news.Title: 台股開盤》台積2500元領軍 大盤站上48K 分析師揭：小心「爆量不漲」
news.Content:
[Newtalk新聞] 台股今天(23日)開紅走高漲逾498點，最高來到48341點，上櫃電子早盤揚升，金融走跌！台積電漲40元、來到2500元，聯發科跌25元、來到5150元。台達電漲15元、來到1915元。廣達跌1元、來到341元。鴻海漲3元、來到256元。

分析師林漢偉表示，今天掌握三個重點：「48000點、科技創高、量能」如下。

第一，美股科技股多頭延續，費半上漲2.06%，美光大漲5.02%，安謀同步走強，顯示資金持續鎖定記憶體、IC設計與半導體，對今天台股電子族群形成正面支撐。

第二，台指期夜盤上漲272點，台積電ADR上漲1.54%，台積電期貨也來到2515元，今天指數具備挑戰48000點條件。不過位置已經來到高檔，真正關鍵是成交量能否「溫和擴增」，避免出現爆量不漲。

第三，中小型股輪動仍然活躍。記憶體看南亞科、華邦電；IC設計看聯發科、信驊、創意；AI供應鏈看智邦、健策、川湖、高力；矽光子則觀察聯亞、華星光整理後能否重新轉強。

林漢偉進一步指出，如果指數站上48000點，同時外資現貨維持買超、櫃買同步突破反壓，代表多頭結構仍有延續空間；反之若指數創高但量價背離，就要提高追價警覺。總結：美科技股續創新高、台積電ADR再漲1.54%；台股挑戰48000點，補量有利續攻，個股鎖定記憶體、IC設計與輪動補漲AI供應鏈。

news.Title: 〈台股開盤〉長假前拚站穩4萬8  台積電率高人氣電子股衝鋒漲500點
news.Content:
台股成交量能不再萎縮，台股指標股權王台積電 (2330-TW) 在除息7元後表現堅挺，今(23)日早盤股價攻堅站上2500元，上漲1.42%，激勵台股集中市場開盤上漲逾500點，最高達48341.56點。在電子股高人氣帶動之下，台股盤勢仍呈現高檔耐高檔震盪格局。

台北股市集中市場大盤23日早盤開盤在47894.77點，最低47894.77點，最高達48341.56點，預估全場成交值超過1億元，大盤成交比重上，電子股上漲1.28%，占大盤成交比重86%，金融股下跌0.69%，占大盤成交比重1%。

台股早盤台積電股價上漲，PCB材料的台光電(2383-TW)漲190元衝破5000元大關，台燿(6274-TW)，唯聯茂(6213-TW)股價下跌； 大立光(3008-TW)下跌85元1.33%、玉晶光(3406-TW)上漲0.87%，今國光(6209-TW)在紅外線鏡頭銷表現佳，9月營收可望改寫新高，早盤有大筆資金急拉，最高達81.5元。

在 IC 載板股方面，欣興 (3037-TW)及景碩 (3189-TW)、南電 (8046-TW)則均出現明顯上漲走勢，並以南電走勢較強。

今天早晨收盤的美股方面，美股晶片股延續漲勢，帶動那斯達克指數連日創收盤新高，費城半導體指數升超 2%，連續第六個交易日收高。銀行股受到美債殖利率曲線趨平壓抑，道瓊下跌 185 點。油價連續第五日走低，則為大盤提供支撐。同時，布蘭特原油期貨下滑 1.09%，收每桶 99.25 美元；西德州原油期貨下跌 1.24%，收每桶 94.59 美元，兩者均連續第五個交易日收黑。

美股的收盤表現上，道瓊工業指數下跌 185.14 點，或 0.36%，報 51,863.69 點。那斯達克指數上漲 122.18 點，或 0.45%，報 27,244.28 點。S&P 500 指數下跌 0.06 點，幾乎持平，報 7,764.64 點。費城半導體指數上漲 256.65 點，或 2.06%，報 12,689.82 點。輝達 (NVDA-US) 漲 0.66%，台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 上漲 1.54%

國票證券指出，AI驅動邏輯晶片與記憶體擴產，帶動長約價格持續上行，產業展望持續往樂觀發展，加上其位階相比其他族群相對較低，有望吸引後續投資人關注。

統一證券指出，美債殖利率止穩搭配油價跌破百元，為科技股提供買盤支撐，費半指數強勢連6漲；回歸台股，受惠AI強勁基本面，台股昨再創歷史新高，目前技術面維持強勢，搭配外銷訂單寫下連19紅及Meta Connect 2026大會等利多，多方動能充沛。但本週五起適逢中秋與教師節長假效應，仍須提防盤中大幅波動，

統一證券預期大盤將維持震盪盤堅走揚，操作建議擇優布局流動性佳的中大型AI權值股，及業績題材股 ，長線追蹤族群：台積電及先進封測、半導體設備、PCB、光傳輸、散熱、連接器、貨櫃散裝、特用化學及高殖利率銀行及壽險股等。

news.Title: 台股成功站回48K！早盤上漲逾500點　台積電攻2500元大關
news.Content:

news.Title: 【Yahoo早盤】台股漲逾500點重返4萬8 投顧董座呂仁傑：慎防開高走低
news.Content:
美股半導體類股走強，加上國際油價回落、美債殖利率下滑，台股今（23）日加權指數以47,894.77點開出、上漲94.6點，盤中漲幅擴大逾500點，最高觸及48,341.56點，資金明顯湧向記憶體及被動元件族群。華南投顧董事長呂仁傑表示，近期指數與個股表現明顯分歧，「大盤雖然創高，多數個股熱度卻已降溫」，今天仍須防範高檔震盪及開高走低風險，盤中有三大觀察重點。

今日值班分析師：華南投顧董事長呂仁傑

呂仁傑指出，今日盤中有三大觀察重點，首先是台積電能否守穩2,460元，這將牽動指數站上48,000點究竟是「真突破」或「假突破」；其次是成交量能否維持在兆元以上，近期台股經常在開盤時爆出大量，之後成交動能逐漸收斂，今日預估成交金額約落在9,000億元至1兆元，可能與昨日相近或略低，若能守住兆元水準，將有利多頭延續；第三則是中秋連假前的節前賣壓，尤其尾盤可能出現持股調節，因此收盤能否站穩48,000點，將是判斷市場信心的重要指標。

呂仁傑認為，台股在昨日創高後、9月下旬至10月初可能以震盪整理為主，但近期成交量逐步放大，反映部分資金已趁區間震盪提前點火與布局。進入10月後，美股重量級企業財報將陸續公布，加上美中高層會談、美伊接觸及聯合國大會期間的外交進展，都可能成為第四季行情的催化劑。若伊朗問題降溫、美中關係出現舒緩跡象，將有助降低地緣政治風險，替10月以後的上漲行情「增添柴火」。

盤面選股方面，呂仁傑表示，AI仍是市場主軸，資金持續圍繞半導體、ASIC、先進製程及人工智慧供應鏈輪動，包括台積電、聯發科、聯電，以及欣興、南電等載板股；AI伺服器、車用電子與工業電腦族群也值得留意。此外，記憶體、被動元件及功率半導體等族群整理後，仍有機會向上表現，近期健策、凌華等AI相關個股保持活躍，也代表題材資金尚未退潮。

操作策略上，呂仁傑認為，今日不必因中秋連假提前大幅降低持股，反而可將震盪拉回視為布局第四季的機會，建議中長線投資人維持約五至六成持股。他指出，台灣外銷訂單表現強勁，加上AI產業基本面並未轉差，若地緣政治情勢持續改善，預期中秋節後指數向上的機會仍較高，整體行情可望由9月底延續至11月，但相關題材告一段落後，仍須留意市場再度進入震盪整理。

馮萱榕／財經特派記者，主跑財政部、電腦通路、觀光餐飲等

news.Title: 台積電、友達、健策、創意等16檔！散戶Q4高勝率大絕招
news.Content:
台股即將進入第四季的傳統旺季，被看好有機會衝上5萬點大關，從過去的統計數據也發現，若從第四季進場買股放到明年的勝率，會比從年中進場的機率高，散戶該如何把握機會，專家利用多項指標篩選出16檔值得關注的標的。

台積電、聯發科勝率高？專家解惑

富邦期貨副總經理張林忠於《理財達人秀》節目上表示，台股第四季上漲機率達66%至80%，平均漲幅達3.7%至4.9%，歷史數據顯示，台積電、漢唐、中信金、聯發科、廣達及0050為6檔勝率較高標的。

另外，張林忠從籌碼面觀察，以近一日股期交易日大於500口、股價高於10日均線且均線向上，以及KD出現黃金交叉等3大條件篩選強勢股，包括友達、新興、聯茂及精材，值得投資人留意。

奇鋐、健策也中選 後市看漲怎麼挑？

張林忠也從投信加持的個股進行篩選，利用今年以來累計營收大於去年同期至少40%，以及近一個月投信基金持股檔數大於150檔等兩大嚴苛條件，挑出6檔獲得投信加持的績優股。

張林忠點名台光電、旺矽、奇鋐、健策、台達電及創意等6檔個股，並從DMI指標觀察近期的強弱狀態，其中台光電與旺矽從線型來看較為弱勢，其餘四檔的狀況較佳。

目前市場普遍看好台股在中秋節過後續揚，尤其近十年的數據顯示，中秋節過後的60個交易日，指數上漲的機率達九成，平均漲幅也有4.8%，因此市場預估台股雖已改寫歷史新高，但短線震盪後將往上推高，人工智慧題材仍是交易主流。

news.Title: 護國神山擴廠狂潮！ 這「廠務巨獸」EPS上看88元 訂單排到2028
news.Content:
隨著台積電持續擴廠，產業鏈受惠的範圍早已不限於台積電本身。冠軍操盤手楊雲翔表示，日月光投控股價近期持續往上走，反映的正是同一件事：AI帶動的不只是單一晶片需求，而是驅動了整條半導體產業鏈都在大規模擴大資本支出。

全球半導體巨頭齊擴產

冠軍操盤手楊雲翔表示，半導體大廠擴產動能相當強勁。台積電持續擴廠，日月光今年資本支出超過3,000億元，聯電也持續在新加坡擴充產能；美光今年資本支出約270億美元，明年甚至規劃提高到470億美元。當全球半導體大廠都在大規模蓋廠時，另一條直接受惠的產業鏈就是廠務工程，包括亞翔（6139）、漢唐（2404）、帆宣（6196），今年上半年獲利都有明顯成長，其中亞翔的成長幅度尤其突出。

亞翔訂單能見度看至2028

楊雲翔指出，亞翔今年市場預估EPS約65元，明年甚至有機會往88元靠近，而真正有意思的是它的在手訂單。亞翔股本大約23億元，在手訂單卻已經來到約4,400億元，而且訂單能見度一路看到2028年。楊雲翔強調：「這些不是還在談的案子，而是已經簽下來、未來幾年要陸續認列的工程。」

搶吃新加坡擴廠紅利

此外，亞翔現在的訂單來源也不再只押寶台灣。新加坡這幾年正成為半導體擴廠重鎮，包括美光的HBM與NAND Flash、聯電，以及世界先進與恩智浦合作的VSMC，都有大型建廠計畫。楊雲翔分析，亞翔的新接訂單裡，新加坡占了很高的比重，等於同時吃到AI、HBM、成熟製程與東南亞半導體擴產需求。

日K三角收斂蓄勢待發

從技術面觀察，楊雲翔表示，亞翔先前從接近千元的位置一路整理，目前來到700元附近，日K形成三角收斂，也開始站上收斂區上緣。楊雲翔認為，目前最大的關鍵始終還是量能，「如果後續成交量能夠明顯放大，代表資金有機會開始從已經漲多的封測族群，往還在整理、但基本面與訂單持續成長的廠務工程族群移動。」

news.Title: 樂金電子液冷設備獲輝達DSX Ready資格，搶進AI工廠供應鏈
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】韓國電子大廠--樂金電子(LG，韓股代碼066570)週二宣布，旗下大型冷卻液分配單元(CDU)通過輝達(Nvidia，美股代碼NVDA)DSX Ready認證，符合其AI工廠平台相關的冷卻設備要求，並列入DSX AI Factory Marketplace。這項資格有助LG電子參與相關數據中心項目選商，但並不等於已取得輝達或客戶訂單。LG韓股當天收在21萬6,500韓元，上漲6.91%成為三十檔大型股(KTOP30)最旺個股。官方資料都指出，該產品已符合DSX Ready的額外要求；LG電子先前的600千瓦與1兆瓦CDU則已完成相關基礎設施資格認定。原文所稱「全球僅三款」未見於這兩份官方公告，暫不列入稿件。

CDU負責讓冷卻液流經貼近晶片的冷板，再將伺服器產生的熱量傳至數據中心冷卻系統。隨著AI伺服器機櫃的功耗與發熱量提高，LG電子希望將大型CDU與冷水機組、機房空氣處理設備結合，提供涵蓋晶片到冷水機組的散熱方案。

韓聯社報導，除了CDU取得輝達資格認定，市場稍後也關注到LG集團與微軟在AI數據中心基礎設施方面的合作消息。對LG電子液冷業務而言，後續關鍵仍是將產品資格轉化為實際採購與項目收入。另據LG英文公告引用的TrendForce預測，AI晶片液冷滲透率約由2024年的14%升至2027年的60%。

news.Title: If You Buy Monster Beverage With $10,000 Today, Could You Become a Millionaire in 25 Years?
news.Content:
Everyone's heard about stocks that have produced phenomenal returns and made investors millionaires. These include companies like Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN) and Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL).

Typically, making a lot of money from your stock investments takes time. After all, these companies didn't turn a $10,000 investment into $1 million overnight. That's 100 times your initial investment.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Monster Beverage (NASDAQ: MNST) has done well for shareholders over the last few years. If you invest $10,000 today, does it have the potential to turn that into $1 million?

Past returns

Over the past 10 years, through Sept. 18, Monster Beverage's shares gained 263%. The company hasn't paid dividends, so that's the return that shareholders received. If you'd invested $10,000, your shares would be worth over $36,000 today.

Of course, that's far short of $1 million. But that's only over 10 years. Monster Beverage's stock generated a 14% annualized return. Earning that rate of return over 25 years results in a value of over $250,000.

By comparison, you'd have been better off investing in a low-cost S&P 500 (SNPINDEX: ^GSPC) index fund. The index returned 326% over a decade, including dividends. If you'd invested $10,000, you'd have nearly $43,000 today.

Required future return

A 14% annualized return is pretty good, but it's still insufficient to make you a millionaire in 25 years. What rate of return would you need?

Monster Beverage's shares would have to return over 20% annually over a quarter of a century. That's a significant increase from the stock's previous return.

That would also require the stock to return nearly double the S&P 500's historical rate. Over 25 years, the index returned 10.4% annually.

Can Monster Beverage make you a millionaire?

Monster Beverage has been a growth stock , and the last five years have been rewarding for shareholders. During this period, the stock gained 91.3%, edging out the S&P 500's 90.6%.

Monster Beverage's energy drinks have struck a chord with consumers. Its second-quarter sales grew 17.9% year over year to $2.5 billion, adjusted for foreign currency translation. Its major business, Monster Energy drinks, drove this growth, with the division's sales growing 19.3% year over year to $2.3 billion.

Story Continues

However, Monster Energy faces competition. Continued sales growth requires the company to stay a step ahead. Additionally, it's uncertain whether energy drinks have proven staying power, or if consumer tastes will shift to something else.

Hence, while the stock has done well lately, I wouldn't count on growth accelerating and the share price gain providing the necessary return to make your $10,000 investment turn into $1 million.

news.Title: Google Goes Nuclear With Power Upgrade Agreement in Georgia
news.Content:
As the massive energy needs of the artificial intelligence (AI) build-out become increasingly apparent, AI companies and utilities alike are growing concerned.

Across the country, opposition to AI data centers has been rising, in part due to the strain these facilities are expected to place on local power grids and water systems.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Alphabet 's (NASDAQ:GOOG) (NASDAQ:GOOGL) Google is the latest company to announce a deal to sweeten the pot for one of its proposed AI facilities by adding capacity to an electrical grid. And it's coming from a source that's been surprisingly popular with AI companies: nuclear power.

Here's what Alphabet is proposing and why nuclear power has become one of energy's hottest trends.

Image source: Getty Images.

AI data centers have never been less popular

AI's reputation as a job-killer has always been a drag on its popularity. That existing stigma seems to have extended to AI data centers.

Residents of communities across the country have lobbied to have the projects canceled. In many cases, they've successfully pressured local politicians and zoning boards to rescind approvals, citing fears about the increased utility bills and pollution such projects would bring.

This kind of local opposition has already delayed or disrupted tens if not hundreds of billions of dollars' worth of AI infrastructure projects. That's prompted AI companies to add electricity generation infrastructure to their projects in hopes of making them more palatable to cost-conscious ratepayers.

But with the Trump Administration openly opposed to solar and wind energy development, an out-of-favor energy source is back in the mix: nuclear.

Upgrading instead of building

Nuclear power was originally adopted because it was cheap to produce – at least, after the enormous upfront costs of building the plant were covered.

Those economics changed as technological advances caused the price of natural gas, solar, and wind power to plunge. By 2018, in fact, a local utility in Iowa decided it was worth paying a $110 million fee to break its existing five-year contract with a local nuclear power plant and switch to cheaper wind and natural gas power.

But even though it's still cheaper to generate electricity using natural gas or wind turbines than nuclear reactors, U.S. electricity demand is outstripping supply. That's expected to make nuclear power competitive again in many areas.

Story Continues

The key is that it needs to be an existing nuclear power plant: the massive start-up cost of a new reactor remains prohibitive. That's why Google has inked an agreement with Georgia Power, the electric utility that covers most of Georgia, to pay for upgrades at two of its existing nuclear plants.

What Google has agreed to

Under the agreement, which has yet to be approved by the Georgia Public Service Commission, Google will pay for "uprates" at Georgia Power's Vogtle and Hatch nuclear plants.

Uprates are performance-improving upgrades that allow a nuclear plant's existing reactor core to operate at a higher temperature, producing more heat and thus more electricity. Uprates can include things like replacing turbines and introducing more efficient cooling systems.

Georgia Power expects the uprates to add about 96 megawatts of new capacity to the electricity grid, which could power tens of thousands of homes. Although the costs of the uprates haven't been specified, a press release from Georgia Power estimates that its customers will receive "approximately $900 million in projected benefits ... over the life of the units."

Image source: The Motley Fool.

Google is betting big on nuclear

Naturally, given the current antipathy toward AI data centers, the press release doesn't mention the unspoken reason for the agreement: Google almost certainly intends to use some or all of the increased output to power its data centers in Georgia. Earlier this month, NextEra Energy secured a $1.9 billion government loan guarantee to restart a shuttered nuclear plant in Iowa to power a Google AI data center there.

With small modular reactor (SMR) companies like Oklo trying to develop data centers powered by on-site SMRs, nuclear power is becoming increasingly closely associated with AI. But it seems unlikely that nuclear power alone will be enough to power the hyperscalers' electricity-hungry AI ambitions, at least not in the near term.

news.Title: What $3,000 Invested in SpaceX Stock Could Grow to by September 2027
news.Content:
For anyone who has invested in Space Exploration Technologies (NASDAQ: SPCX) since its June 12 initial public offering (IPO), it's been quite the roller-coaster ride. Shares opened to the public at $150 and since traded as high as $225.64 and as low as $104.83 per share.

As of the closing price of Sept. 18, shares are almost right back where they started at $152.71. For anyone who hasn't invested yet or who has but may be considering adding more shares, there are likely to be more wild price swings for the foreseeable future. SpaceX is unprofitable and needs to spend heavily to build out a new wave of artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure in space.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

That said, by September 2027, analysts appear generally bullish on where the SpaceX stock price could be trading.

What a $3,000 investment in SpaceX could be worth

Price targets aren't guarantees, and they shouldn't be the full deciding factor for whether to invest in a company. Rather, they can help an investor decide whether the potential rewards outweigh the risks.

With that in mind, the median one-year price target among the 41 analysts covering the company is $212, according to CNN. From the Sept. 18 closing price of $152.71, that would represent a gain of 38.8% by SpaceX investors in September 2027.

A $3,000 investment at the Sept. 18 closing price would equal more than 19 shares through fractional investing. So, if the SpaceX stock price were to reach $212 by September 2027, that $3,000 investment would be worth approximately $4,163.

To expand on that a little further for a broader outlook, we can also look at the bear case through the group's lowest price target of $75. If the SpaceX stock price were to sink that low, that $3,000 would essentially be halved to $1,473. I'll skip running these hypothetical examples against the highest price target, $800, which would likely take SpaceX years to hit rather than occur in the next 12 months.

Is SpaceX worth an investment consideration?

A more conservative investor may want to consider passing on owning shares of SpaceX for the time being. For the second quarter of 2026, the company reported a net loss of $541 million, better than the $1 billion loss in the prior-year period, but still a loss. Also, SpaceX is spending heavily, particularly on its AI division, which accounted for $15.8 billion of the $18.3 billion in capital expenditures for the second quarter of 2026.

Story Continues

For more aggressive investors who are prepared to handle the volatility and can give SpaceX more time to accomplish its goals, that median forecast gain of 38.8% by September 2027 could pale in comparison to the long-term gains the company could offer, which that $800 price target mentioned earlier is likely reflecting. SpaceX is giving an early preview of the revenue it could generate by establishing AI infrastructure through deals in which Anthropic and Alphabet rent out compute capacity from its data centers, with the two contracts combined valued at $26 billion annually.

These types of deals could extend even further for SpaceX as it establishes AI infrastructure in space, having previously submitted plans to launch more than 1 million satellites to serve as space-based data centers, with initial launches expected in 2028. SpaceX just needs to execute to make that a reality. Shareholders need to give the company time to make it happen and be prepared for any potential missteps along the way.

news.Title: 2 Beaten-Down Stocks to Buy Before They Bounce Back
news.Content:
Shopify (NASDAQ:SHOP) and Intuitive Surgical (NASDAQ:ISRG) were considered market darlings for a long time, but in recent years, they have faced significant headwinds that have threatened their status. Both stocks have dropped substantially this year. Shopify is down 19% while Intuitive Surgical has declined 29%. However, there are reasons to remain bullish on both stocks and to buy the dip before they rebound. Let me explain.

Image source: The Motley Fool.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

1. Shopify

Shopify's second-quarter results were excellent. The company's revenue came in at $3.6 billion, 34% higher than the year-ago period. The company's operating income of $488 million jumped almost 68% year over year, while its non- GAAP net income of $439 million, which excludes the impact of equity investments, grew 30% year over year. Shopify's third-quarter guidance came in ahead of analyst estimates, too.

The stock jumped after its latest quarterly update, but it remains down by 9% over the last 12 months. What's going on? Some investors remain worried that artificial intelligence (AI) will eventually replace some of Shopify's services. Further, the company trades at 53.2x forward earnings, which seems a bit too steep for a company with somewhat uncertain prospects, given how quickly AI continues to develop.

But is Shopify really in danger of losing out to AI? In my view, the evidence suggests otherwise. The e-commerce specialist has launched various AI-powered initiatives that are helping boost the productivity of merchants on its platforms. Thanks to AI, Shopify's clients can build storefronts much more easily, write up product descriptions more quickly, better analyze data, make products easier to find through AI-powered searches, and much more.

These initiatives are working, as management noted, and Shopify won't stop there. The company will continue integrating AI across its platform to help merchants and their customers. The company's services are unlikely to be completely replaced by the technology, in my view. AI could, instead, be a net benefit to the business. Meanwhile, the shift toward e-commerce continues unabated, and Shopify remains a leader in the industry, with a strong competitive advantage stemming from switching costs. All these factors make the stock an attractive pick on the dip.

Story Continues

2. Intuitive Surgical

Intuitive Surgical is a leader in the robotic-assisted surgery (RAS) market, offering the da Vinci system, one of the industry's leading devices. However, the company is facing increased competition, notably from Medtronic (NYSE:MDT), which earned U.S. clearance for its Hugo RAS system for urologic procedures in December of last year. Further, Intuitive Surgical's shares are hardly cheap.

The company is trading at 32.6x forward earnings. Can Intuitive Surgical bounce back? Yes, it can, and here's why. The company has a solid market lead, and that's unlikely to change even with mounting competition. The da Vinci system has been around for more than 25 years and has a large installed base of 11,710 devices as of the end of the second quarter. So, it has achieved widespread adoption and accumulated extensive real-world use.

This large installed base also helps Intuitive Surgical improve its devices by enabling it to receive feedback from surgeons. The company's latest version of the da Vinci system boasts several new features, including Force Feedback Technology, which allows physicians to better feel the pressure they are applying to patients' tissues during procedures.

So, Intuitive Surgical has a first-mover advantage and a data flywheel: a larger installed base provides more data to analyze and improve its da Vinci system, which then attracts more surgeons and generates more data. But it's also worth noting that Intuitive Surgical benefits from high switching costs, given that its devices carry high upfront costs for hospitals, not to mention the time it takes to train surgeons to use them.

Meanwhile, Intuitive Surgical is still looking at a large addressable opportunity in the underpenetrated RAS market, which, by the way, will only expand over the long run as the world's population ages. Given all that, Intuitive Surgical's prospects still appear attractive, and the company's shares are worth buying at current levels.

news.Title: Nvidia Backed SB Energy’s $50 Billion Valuation Push. Wall Street Just Hit the Brakes
news.Content: SB Energy's planned public listing is turning into a stress test for the financing side of the AI buildout. The SoftBank-backed developer has slowed preparations for an IPO that had been discussed around a $50 billion valuation, according to a September 22 Financial Times report, while a $4.9 billion debt package has faced weak demand and yields around 10%. NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ: NVDA ) has already invested $1.5 billion and committed another $1.5 billion tied to the IPO. American Electric Power Company, Inc. (NASDAQ: AEP ) sits on the other side of the same buildout through AEP Ohio's regional power partnership around SB Energy's huge Ohio campus. The contracts are huge, but the capital bill is larger SB Energy says it has signed roughly 8.8 gigawatts of IT lease capacity, including the PORTS-Pike campus in Ohio for OpenAI. Nvidia is the exclusive AI-compute provider for that site and is providing credit support for an initial 4.25 gigawatts, with an option covering another 3.75. That is attractive for NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA) because it can turn a developer's financing into future demand for GPUs, networking and systems. The risk is the scale of the guarantee structure. Nvidia has disclosed maximum guarantee exposure that can reach $105 billion under defined conditions, so the economics become more intertwined with OpenAI's ability to meet its lease obligations. American Electric Power Company, Inc. (NASDAQ:AEP) benefits from the electricity and transmission side. AEP has about 69 gigawatts of contracted load additions through 2030, with roughly 90% tied to data centers, and the SB Energy/SoftBank regional plan includes cooperation with AEP Ohio. Large-load tariffs, collateral and termination provisions can protect utility shareholders, but proposed demand is not the same thing as completed generation and transmission. Regulatory approvals and construction timing decide when that load becomes earnings. The bond market is asking for proof Insider Monkey's database counted 285 Nvidia hedge-fund holders in Q2 2026, up from 275 in Q1, while Fisher Asset Management increased its stake about 3%. AEP had about 65 hedge-fund holders in Q2, up from roughly 62 in Q1; GQG Partners remained the largest disclosed hedge-fund holder on Insider Monkey's page with 10.26 million shares after reducing its position 32%. The filings predate the IPO slowdown. The IPO slowdown does not mean AI demand disappeared. It says investors are starting to distinguish between contracted demand and financeable returns. Nvidia can still sell the compute, and AEP can still earn on grid investment, even if SB Energy's equity valuation comes down. But when a developer with OpenAI, SoftBank and Nvidia behind it still has to pay close to double-digit debt yields, the cost of capital has officially become part of the AI thesis. news.Title: Google Is Taking Its AI Chips Outside the Cloud. Nvidia Just Got a New Sovereign-AI Rival
news.Content:
Google is testing whether its custom AI chips can become national infrastructure instead of remaining mostly a cloud advantage. A September 22 report from Seoul Economic Daily said Google met South Korean officials on September 9 to discuss supplying tensor processing units for the country's sovereign-AI buildout. That puts Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ: GOOGL ) into a market where governments have leaned heavily on NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ: NVDA ) GPUs, and it matters because Korea wants ess dependence on a single foreign supplier and more control over its compute strategy.

The important change is where the TPU can live

Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL) has spent years using TPUs to lower the cost of running its own models and Google Cloud workloads. Supplying TPUs more directly to universities, research organizations or on-premise sovereign installations would widen the addressable market and weaken one of Nvidia's strongest structural advantages: Nvidia has long dominated high-performance accelerators outside hyperscaler clouds. Google reportedly argues that TPUs can lower AI-compute costs materially, but those claims depend on workload, software support and utilization.

The bear case for Google is interoperability. Nvidia has spent years turning CUDA, networking and systems software into a platform that developers already know. A government can want diversification and still decide that migration costs or software maturity make GPUs the safer choice. Google also has to support external customers without diluting the economic advantage that helped differentiate its own cloud.

Nvidia can lose share without losing the market

For NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA), sovereign AI remains a huge opportunity because countries are treating compute as strategic infrastructure. The threat is that the same strategic logic encourages governments to avoid a single vendor. A Korean TPU deployment would not mean Nvidia has been displaced, but it could establish a template for splitting national clusters across competing architectures.

Insider Monkey's database showed 275 hedge funds holding Alphabet at the end of Q2 2026, up from 265 in Q1. Berkshire Hathaway increased its Class A Alphabet position about 45% during the quarter. Nvidia's holder count rose to 285 from 275, while Fisher Asset Management increased its stake about 3%. Both filings predate the September Korea discussions. Alphabet short interest was 77.70 million shares as of August 31, around 0.72% of float with 3.48 days to cover.

Story Continues

The investable question is therefore broader than whose chip is faster. Google is trying to export a hardware advantage that used to reinforce Cloud, while Nvidia is defending the default architecture for almost everyone else. If sovereign buyers insist on second sources, both can grow while Nvidia's share of incremental spending slips. That is a much more credible competitive threat than expecting governments to rip out existing GPU stacks overnight.

While we acknowledge the potential of GOOGL and NVDA as investments, we believe certain other AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. news.Title: Meta AI agent triggers heavy selloff in banks, insurers, and travel stocks
news.Content:
Investing.com -- A sudden artificial intelligence breakthrough is reshaping Wall Street. Financials, travel, and telecom stocks tumbled Tuesday as investors fear Meta's new Muse AI agent will eliminate customer friction—the long-standing habit of sticking with overpriced or underperforming services simply to avoid the hassle of switching.

Disruption Across Habit-Driven Industries

The aggressive sector rotation stems from the rapid ascent of Meta's Muse, which recently hit No. 1 on Apple's US App Store. The AI assistant goes beyond answering questions by autonomously executing digital tasks on a user's behalf. Investors are waking up to a future where AI agents continuously optimize personal finances: moving cash into higher-yielding accounts, canceling neglected memberships, renegotiating telecom plans, and automatically switching policies when cheaper rates appear.

Following Muse's viral success, which sent Meta shares up 11% on Monday, a Goldman Sachs trading desk note warned that industries reliant on recurring bills, add-ons, and customer passivity face severe disruption.

The fallout hit multiple sectors on Tuesday:

Insurance & Price Shopping: Allstate Corp. tumbled 6.0% alongside declines in Progressive Corp. as Wall Street priced in the threat of automated price shopping. With AI agents capable of silently scanning policy rates in real time and re-shopping coverage at renewal, insurers face the erosion of long-term policyholder retention and pricing power.

Banking & Wealth Management: The S&P 500 Financials Index dropped up to 2.4% to its lowest level since July. Charles Schwab (SCHW) led the financial plunge, sinking 6.7%, while banking giants JPMorgan Chase, Morgan Stanley, and Wells Fargo each slid more than 2.5%.

Travel & Subscriptions: Online booking sites Expedia (-3.7%) and Booking Holdings (-3.9%) fell sharply over fears that AI agents will bypass aggregate booking portals. Gym chain Planet Fitness, whose business model relies heavily on uncancelled, unused memberships, plummeted as much as 11%.

Telecom: Major US carriers dropped as traders anticipated a new era of effortless carrier-switching. Verizon Communications fell 2.8%, while AT&T and T-Mobile US were flagged by Goldman Sachs as being highly exposed to disruption if AI agents begin automatically negotiating or migrating phone plans.

The 'Ghost Member' Trap: Planet Fitness Takes a Direct Hit

Among the day's sharpest casualties was Planet Fitness Inc., which plummeted 10.6% as investors confronted the vulnerability of friction-based subscription models. Planet Fitness has long relied on passive revenue from "ghost members"—customers who continue paying $10 to $25 per month for memberships they rarely or never use because the friction of canceling manually feels greater than the recurring charge.

Story Continues

With personal AI agents like Muse capable of routinely auditing bank statements, identifying zero-usage subscriptions, and executing multi-step cancellation processes autonomously, Wall Street fears gym chains could see an erosion in the steady stream of unearned recurring revenue that underpins their business model.

AI as the New "Toll Collector"

Bloomberg Intelligence analysts Mandeep Singh and William Tong highlighted that personal AI assistants have the potential to redirect customer traffic away from established digital storefronts. They predict platforms like Muse will act as new digital "toll collectors," capturing transaction revenue directly as commerce moves through AI interfaces rather than traditional websites and apps.

news.Title: Dear Microsoft Stock Fans, Mark Your Calendars for September 24
news.Content:
Every so often, a date on the calendar quietly becomes bigger than initial expectations. Sept. 24 could be one of those days for Microsoft (MSFT) investors.

It is not an earnings date or a product launch. Yet, what happens in Washington that evening could say a lot about where Microsoft, and the entire AI race, is headed next. Before I get to why this dinner matters for Microsoft stock, it helps to understand where the company stands right now and why its seat at this table is no coincidence.

More News from Barchart

SpaceX Has Huge, Unusual Put Options Volume - Is SPCX Set to Fall or Rise From Here?

Lucid Just Struck a Partnership With Bolt on Mobility. What This Means for LCID Stock.

Why It's Time to Load Up on Meta Stock

Tired of missing midday reversals? The FREE Barchart Brief newsletter keeps you in the know. Sign up now!

Microsoft Stock Rides a Record AI-Driven Year

Microsoft just closed out fiscal 2026 (ended in June) with annual revenue topping $331 billion, up 18%. Cloud surpassed $214 billion in sales, growing 27%, while Azure crossed the $100 billion mark with 41% growth for the year, according to remarks CEO Satya Nadella made during the fiscal fourth-quarter earnings call.

Azure grew 43% in the most recent quarter, and CFO Amy Hood told investors on the call that demand continues to exceed available supply, even as it works to bring new data center capacity online at an accelerated pace.

Microsoft 365 Copilot is also scaling fast. Paid seats crossed 30 million, with net new seat additions more than doubling from the prior quarter. Nadella described Copilot's evolution from a simple chat tool into something closer to an everyday operating system for work, wired into a company's security, finance, and business processes.

Underneath it all sits a theme Nadella has repeated often this year: AI sovereignty. Companies and countries alike want control over their own data, models, and intellectual property, rather than handing it over to a single outside provider.

The idea has shaped Microsoft's approach to everything from its new partnership bringing Mistral models to Microsoft Sovereign Cloud to its support of more than 11,000 models across the Azure platform.

Investors Eye the Xi Dinner

Nadella plans to attend a White House state dinner honoring Chinese President Xi Jinping, joining a lineup of leaders from Apple (AAPL), OpenAI, and Nvidia (NVDA), according to a person familiar with the planning cited by Bloomberg . Microsoft declined to comment on the matter.

The guest list reads like a who's who of American technology. Amazon (AMZN) founder Jeff Bezos, Tesla (TSLA) CEO Elon Musk, and Alphabet (GOOG) (GOOGL) chief Sundar Pichai are expected to attend, U.S. officials said.

Story Continues

Apple Executive Chairman Tim Cook, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, and Qualcomm (QCOM) head Cristiano Amon are also set to be there. OpenAI President Greg Brockman will join alongside CEO Sam Altman, OpenAI confirmed Monday. CNBC reported additional names on the U.S. side, including Citigroup (C) CEO Jane Fraser and Dell (DELL) founder Michael Dell, citing a source familiar with the planning.

From China, executives from BYD (BYDDY), Xiaomi (XIACY), CATL, Gotion, Hisense, Wanxiang, Bank of China, and COFCO Group were under consideration to join Xi, Reuters reported, citing sources.

The summit comes amid a heated industry debate over how fast AI should move. Just last week, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called for an industry-wide slowdown in AI development, warning of risks including large-scale cyberattacks, Bloomberg reported.

The Trump administration has pushed back on that idea, arguing that slowing down would hand China an advantage. China's government has criticized Amodei's comments as well, calling them fear-mongering.

What It Means for MSFT Stock Going Forward

For Microsoft, a seat at this dinner puts Nadella directly in the conversation shaping AI policy, trade, and competition between the world's two largest economies, at a moment when his company is betting big on sovereignty, model diversity, and trust as the foundation of its next decade of growth.

Nadella has spoken openly about wanting every enterprise, and by extension every nation, to control its own continuous learning loop rather than outsourcing its intellectual property to any single provider.

A dinner table that includes both American tech leaders and Chinese business figures is, in many ways, a real-world test of that exact philosophy playing out on the world stage. Investors watching Microsoft stock price action into the end of September may find the headlines from that evening just as telling as the next earnings report.

Out of the 51 analysts covering MSFT stock, 41 recommend "Strong Buy," six recommend "Moderate Buy," and four recommend "Hold." The average MSFT price target is $562.33, above the current price of about $502.

news.Title: Gross-Margin Expansion is a Key Driver of SPOT's Profitability
news.Content:
Spotify Technology SPOT saw its second-quarter profitability receive a lift from gross-margin expansion, highlighting economics across its audio platform. Gross margin reached 33.4%, increasing 193 basis points year over year. The improvement reflected gains in the Premium and Ad-Supported businesses, although the underlying drivers differed across the two segments.

Within Premium, revenues grew faster than music costs after accounting for marketplace programs. Lower audiobook and video-podcast costs also supported the segment's margin performance. Together, these factors indicate that Spotify is generating stronger returns from its subscription business while managing the expenses associated with broadening its content offering.

Spotify Technology Gross Margin (TTM)

Spotify Technology gross-margin-ttm | Spotify Technology Quote

The Ad-Supported segment contributed to the profitability improvement. Favorable podcast and tax effects more than offset higher music costs and other costs of revenue. This balance is important because it shows that benefits outside the subscription operation helped strengthen gross profitability despite continuing cost pressure in advertising-supported activities.

Spotify reported operating income of €655 million in the quarter, translating its gross-margin progress into operating profitability. However, expenses increased due to temporary investments in marketing and cloud and artificial intelligence initiatives, excluding social charges. Operating expenses also included €1 million in social charges related to share-based compensation. These investments raised near-term spending but did not prevent the company from delivering substantial operating income.

Overall, the quarter's central takeaway is that margin expansion remains a key pillar of Spotify's profitability story. Revenue growth outpacing relevant content costs in Premium, combined with podcast and tax benefits in Ad-Supported, strengthened the company's earnings structure. At the same time, Spotify continued funding marketing and cloud and AI capabilities. With 7,302 full-time employees worldwide at quarter-end, the company is balancing cost discipline with investment intended to support its platform and operations. The results suggest Spotify's improving cost-to-revenue relationship, rather than expense restraint, drove the quarter's profitability advance.

How Do Two Streaming Peers Compare?

Apple AAPL and Amazon AMZN remain peers in audio streaming. Apple benefits from tight integration between its music service and device ecosystem, while Amazon can connect streaming with Prime memberships and smart speakers. Spotify, however, relies more directly on subscriber growth, ARPU gains and advertising execution because audio anchors its business. For investors, Apple represents an ecosystem-led model, whereas Amazon demonstrates the appeal of bundled services. Spotify's improving monetization indicates that its focused strategy remains competitive.

news.Title: 台股創高怕追貴？分析師點名6檔半導體ETF　聚焦第4季布局
news.Content:
陳唯泰 建議，投資人若擔心行情漲太快，不妨聚焦於半導體相關的ETF。示意圖，與新聞個案無關。（資料照，中央社）

台股今日再創盤中歷史新高；開盤上漲262點，隨後漲幅擴大，早盤最高衝上48601.53點，創下盤中歷史新高紀錄。盤中飆上史上新高後，漲幅急速收斂，加權指數終場上漲81點，以47800點作收。對此，仲英財富分析師陳唯泰於節目《財經一路發》中分析第4季（Q4）指數股票型基金（ETF）佈局觀察。

陳唯泰表示，在美國聯準會（Fed）的不確定因素結束後，台股今日再度走高，這呼應了他之前的分析。除此之外，本次上漲主軸落在電子股，並以半導體為發動重心，特別是封測族群；以日月光為例，它今日的領先指標上漲了4.5%。其餘較低階的個股如力成、華東，也在今日呈現多方趨勢的走勢。陳唯泰指出，強勢的封測也帶動了積體電路（IC）設計族群，如聯發科的股價創下波段性新高，這顯示了正面的多方訊號。

陳唯泰指出，近期狀況顯示，儘管投資人仍對ETF抱有興趣，卻未如上半年那般風行，成交量、受益人數的增加均呈現放緩，未有大幅增加，但投資人仍可以偏多思維操作。

陳唯泰說道，以近日盤面分析，半導體相關族群仍佔有非常大的比重；除此之外，外資自上周四至今，均買超超過千億，且集中於半導體相關個股如台積電、聯發科、南亞科和日月光等。投資人若擔心行情漲太快，不妨聚焦於半導體相關的ETF。

陳唯泰建議，投資人可以考慮6檔半導體相關ETF，分別是中信關鍵半導體（00891）、富邦台灣半導體（00892）、台新台灣半導體（00904）、兆豐台灣晶圓製造（00913）、群益半導體收益（00927）和台新台灣IC設計（00947）。這些半導體相關ETF均有配息，其中00892和00913為半年配息，不過目前已配完息；而00891為季配，分別在2、5、8和11月配息，其餘00904、00927和00947都會在10月配息。
