news.Title: 台股衝不上去「留一根超長上影線」　分析師示警明起迎大震盪：關鍵在台積電身上
news.Content:
台股22日開盤強勢勁揚，不過隨後獲利賣壓出籠，漲勢收斂，終場僅小漲81.33點、收在47800.17點。示意圖。（資料照，顏麟宇攝）

台股今（22）日開盤強勢勁揚，早盤更大漲將近900點，不過隨後獲利賣壓出籠，漲勢收斂，加權指數終場僅小漲81.33點、收在47800.17點，成交量1兆232億；台積電則是由紅翻黑，收盤下跌20元，收2460元。分析師 顧奎國 21日在節目《阪田戰法》中分析，台股這波漲勢可能就要告一段落，周三起震盪幅度將明顯擴大。​

顧奎國表示，台股本波的多方轉折可能將近尾聲，從周三起震盪勢必會擴大，接下來大盤會是續攻或轉跌，關鍵還是在台積電身上。他預估台積電股價後市仍上看2670到2705元，不過在短線上，會面臨2500到2535元的壓力區，上攻空間有限。

顧奎國提到，台股在21日的成交量萎縮到約8200億元，呈現量價背離，若量能無法放大，指數容易拉回；另外在個股漲跌結構上，當天約有6成個股不漲反跌，顯示指數雖維持高檔，但主要仍由台積電等大型權值股撐盤，市場整體動能不算全面。

​顧奎國指出，台股上周五大漲時，官股單日賣超達235.78億元，創近期最高紀錄，而從歷史數據觀察，當官股在指數高檔卻大量賣超時，通常在1到2個交易日後，盤面高機率會出現高點轉折。不過這也不代表官股看壞後市，可能只是基於穩定金融市場、保留資金等考量，待拉回後再進場護盤。

顧奎國分析，目前多頭基本面仍未改變，不過在中秋連假前，若指數已逼近高檔壓力區，可適度減碼並提高現金比重；相對地若指數在假前就已拉回，就可以增加持股，抱股過節。

news.Title: Meta's New Muse AI App Tops Charts, Draws Strong Reviews
news.Content:
Meta Platforms Inc.'s new artificial intelligence agent, Muse, is ranked the No. 1 free app on the US Apple Inc. iOS App and Google Play stores.Muse was downloaded more than 902,000 times in the six days after Meta introduced it on Sept. 8, and is available for people 18 years and older. Bloomberg's Mandeep Singh joins to discuss.

Video Transcript

00:00 Speaker A

This app has got a couple of very good use cases uh to serve as personal agents, which is what they're pitching for. Uh so I'll mention, you know, uh just if you want discount codes for any brand that you're shopping on the internet, like you you look for discount codes through Google searches and all that, just ask um muse a question and it will give you the best discount codes.

00:23 Speaker B

But do the discount codes work? Because I ask Google the same thing and Google will give me a whole bunch of discount codes and when you apply it, it says, nope, not not applicable.

00:33 Speaker A

It it it does for the most part. And you bring up a very good point. So the challenge for this is, in theory, it scrapes all the best information from the internet. But what if uh, you know, a retailer like Amazon blocks you or it doesn't give you the most up-to-date information and that's where the agent may not work as desired because it doesn't have that latest information, not because it can't, but because, you know, the retailers who own the inventory don't want it to be integrated, you know, with what they're doing. And so in this case, Amazon probably will end up launching their own agent, but I would expect that agent to work in conjunction with what Meta is doing because there will be a lot of agent-to-agent traffic and shopping where the human user is completely gone. It's your agent working with that retailer's agent and doing the transaction.

01:29 Speaker C

All right, I've got a use case. Now this will not work with Matt Miller, but it works for me. I arbitrage Lift and Uber. and it really works. You're not loyal to either. No, I could kill less. I'm just looking for the best price. This will do that for me, it sounds like.

01:50 Speaker B

Go for it.

01:51 Speaker A

It will. any sort of price comparisons that involve opening three different apps and doing a price comparison or three different websites. This can do it very efficiently. and not only will it pull the links in terms of what you have to do, it can actually do the full transaction because they want to integrate payments, they want to do this end to end, an agent working on behalf of the user. So in theory, this is very powerful. The challenges is in the ecosystem. You want the payment rails to be integrated, you want all the retailers who have that actual supply, if you're booking travel, Airbnb or booking uh hotel that's showing up, you want this agent to be able to do this end-to-end. What if Airbnb doesn't support it, like Amazon. So that's where this can uh fall short. But

02:44 Speaker B

So it can come up with the information for you, but then you have to execute it on your own.

02:48 Speaker A

Well, or it may not even do that part. Yeah, that so the agent is very capable of executing it all the way through.

02:54 Speaker B

But it just doesn't have access.

02:55 Speaker A

It doesn't have access.

02:56 Speaker B

Well, that's not helpful, you know? I mean, if I'm looking for a place to stay, I want it to look up Airbnb along with other hotels.

03:03 Speaker C

Exactly. So what does it mean for Airbnb and booking.com and all these other sites?

03:07 Speaker A

I mean, all these companies, the reason why you see Amazon resisting this or any other platform that is likely to resist is because they will lose direct traffic. All the like look at what you do on Amazon. You go to the Amazon page, you spend five minutes looking at different items, Amazon shows you 10 different ads, they make so much money when you are searching and showing you sponsored ads. news.Title: Wall Street Loves This EV Stock. Here's Why I'm Not Buying.
news.Content:
Tesla (NASDAQ: TSLA) CEO Elon Musk recently shared that the upcoming Tesla Roadster will be the last new Tesla model you can drive yourself. Afterward, Tesla's newer models will be designed for completely autonomous driving.

Robotaxis are now expected to reach scale in large metro markets by 2030. "Overall, experts expect that robo-taxis will be the first commercial application for L4 in mobility -- not privately owned cars," concludes McKinsey & Co.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 15x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Selling EVs in the future requires not only attracting consumers but also enticing robotaxi operators to buy your vehicles en masse to power their robotaxi fleets. On this front, Lucid Group (NASDAQ: LCID) is at a particular disadvantage versus the competition.

This is why I'm avoiding Lucid Group stock

According to some experts, robotaxis could become a $10 trillion global market. Robotaxi operators like Tesla can manufacture their own vehicles, reducing cost and improving their ability to scale quickly. Robotaxi peers such as Uber Technologies , however, lack internal manufacturing capacities. They will need to source vehicles from third parties to power their autonomous vehicle networks .

Similar to Tesla, these robotaxi operators will want to keep costs as low as possible to scale as quickly as possible. That requires suppliers of robotaxi vehicles to build economies of scale and lower their own production costs in order to provide these vehicles to robotaxi operators at attractive prices.

Tesla, of course, can already produce vehicles for itself cheaply. Rivian , meanwhile, recently launched its first model priced under $50,000. Lucid, however, still lacks an affordable model. And its production capacities severely lag those of Tesla and Rivian, reducing the company's ability to hit economies of scale.

Lucid's lack of scale and affordable models hasn't stopped robotaxi operators, including Uber, from signing deals with the company. But when it comes to becoming a critical supplier to the robotaxi industry, an EV stock like Rivian is far ahead of Lucid. This alone is enough to prevent me from investing, even though several Wall Street analysts remain bullish on the company's future.

news.Title: U.S. M2 Money Supply Recently Grew at the Fastest Pace Seen in 3 Years. It Could Be an Ominous Sign With Inflation at 3.4%.
news.Content: Inflation continues to be an issue for the Federal Reserve, so much so that the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) just raised the federal funds rate for the first time in three years. In August, inflation clocked in 3.4% higher year over year on a seasonally adjusted basis, according to the Consumer Price Index (CPI). Excluding more volatile food and energy prices, core CPI rose 2.4%. Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 15x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue » That's not where the Fed would like it, but it's a far cry from when the CPI surpassed 9% in 2022, marking the highest inflation in 40 years. While inflation has made progress, it has not shown clear progress toward the Fed's 2% target this year. And in July, the U.S. M2 money supply grew at the fastest level seen in three years. It could be an ominous sign for inflation . What is the M2 money supply, and what does it have to do with inflation? There are M1 and M2 money supplies. M1 is cash in circulation and money that can very easily be converted to cash, such as funds in a checking or savings account. M2 money supply is M1 plus time deposits of less than $100,000 and money market funds, so now we're talking about funds in banks earning higher interest rates, driven by prevailing market rates. Some economists view the money supply as a leading indicator of inflation because if there's more money circulating in the system, there's more money available to be spent, driving demand and, therefore, prices. As you can see in the chart, the money supply has expanded tremendously since the turn of the century. This has been driven by economic growth, quantitative easing by the Federal Reserve during financial crises, low interest rates, and deficit spending by the U.S. government. US M2 Money Supply data by YCharts In July of this year, the most recent month for which data is available, the M2 money supply grew roughly 5.4% year over year. That's the fastest growth seen since June 2022, when inflation was raging. What could explain the recent acceleration in M2 growth? Regarding the M2 money supply, a few factors could be driving it higher. The Fed ended quantitative tightening last December, during which it had been letting maturing bonds roll off its massive balance sheet without reinvesting the proceeds into new bonds. That had effectively been draining liquidity from the economy. Around the same time, the Fed once again effectively restarted QE and began buying bonds, pumping money into the economy. Story Continues This time, the Fed labeled its efforts reserve management purchases (RMP). The agency began doing RMPs because it noticed that liquidity in certain overnight funding markets that supply bank reserves had become too tight. Another potential reason for the faster growth in M2 could be the large increase in asset and stock prices in recent years. While these are not included in M2 specifically, people could take profits and move them to accounts included in M2. There's also been growth in bank lending. Is M2 a leading indicator of inflation? As with most economic data points, there's considerable debate over whether an increase in M2 is directly indicative of inflation. Both current Fed Chair Kevin Warsh and former Fed Chair Jerome Powell have expressed differing views over the years. Five years ago, Powell, according to Barron's , told Congress that M2 "doesn't really have important implications for the economic outlook." Powell added, "The classic relationship no longer holds...It's something we have to unlearn." However, during a semiannual monetary policy announcement in July, Warsh mentioned the M2 as a way to "measure the stock of money." In a hearing before Congress regarding this report, Warsh added that had the Fed paid closer attention to M2 supply during the pandemic, the agency might have seen the high inflation coming. Between May 2020 and March 2021, the M2 money supply grew at least 20% annually each month, reaching nearly 27% one month during that window. "I do not show up here as a monetarist. I do not show up and say the secret to inflation is, if we only knew M2, everything would be ​swell," Warsh said, according to Reuters. "My view is that a modern central banker should have a mosaic of information... " So, it's clear that the extent to which M2 directly indicates inflation is debatable. It's also worth noting that inflation is more supply-side driven right now due to higher oil prices. But I would agree with Warsh that one data point will never tell the whole story, especially when you consider everything that has happened in recent years. Investors need to do their best to monitor a multitude of data points as they try to figure out which direction inflation is headed. news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

Meta Platforms ( NASDAQ:META ), the social-media and AI giant, turned Muse's explosive early adoption into a real-world test of whether consumer AI can become a meaningful subscription business. Shares gained approximately 0.5% to $744.80 Tuesday.

The harder part comes next: converting that attention into cash. Muse currently combines free access with $20 and $100 monthly plans, while Jefferies modeled a longer-term scenario of one billion users, a 3% paid-conversion rate and roughly $10.8 billion in annual revenue. That would translate into 30 million paying subscribers generating an average of about $360 each per year, or $30 per month.

In other words, the market is still pricing Meta below that intrinsic-value benchmark even as investors begin testing whether Muse can open another multibillion-dollar revenue engine.

But hyperscale training, massive networking demands and unpredictable peak workloads still play directly into Nvidia's territory. For Nvidia investors, the real risk starts only if local AI becomes a structural substitute for cloud inference rather than another layer of the computing stack.

news.Title: Nvidia Just Gave Einride Stock a Big Boost. How to Play ENRD Here.
news.Content:
Einride (ENRD) has quickly become one of the most closely watched newly public names on Nasdaq since its blockbuster SPAC debut in June 2026. The Stockholm-based technology company is building what it calls a Freight-Capacity-as-a-Service platform, a combination of electric trucks, AI-driven logistics software, and charging infrastructure designed to modernize freight transport. Backed by high-profile partnerships with Amazon (AMZN), Tesla (TSLA), and now Nvidia (NVDA), Einride is racing to prove that its driverless truck technology can scale into a profitable business.

A Rollercoaster Ride Since Going Public

Few recent IPOs have experienced volatility quite like Einride's. Shares have recently traded in a range of roughly $3.84 to $4.56, a dramatic decline of about 87% from the stock's 52-week high of $34, set on its very first trading day, when shares briefly spiked more than 100% before being halted. ENRD stock touched a fresh 52-week low near $3.40 in early September, a steep deflation pattern common among newly listed SPAC mergers once initial hype fades.

More News from Barchart

SpaceX Has Huge, Unusual Put Options Volume - Is SPCX Set to Fall or Rise From Here?

Lucid Just Struck a Partnership With Bolt on Mobility. What This Means for LCID Stock.

Why It's Time to Load Up on Meta Stock

Stop Missing Market Moves: Get the FREE Barchart Brief – your midday dose of stock movers, trending sectors, and actionable trade ideas, delivered right to your inbox. Sign Up Now!

By comparison, the Dow Jones Transportation Average ($DOWT), the benchmark most closely tracking freight, logistics, and trucking companies, has traded in a choppy range in 2026, recently near 20,767 within a 52-week band of roughly 15,064 to 24,752. Einride's stock has dramatically underperformed this transportation-sector benchmark, underscoring the steep post-IPO correction typical of early-stage, pre-profitability autonomous freight companies compared to established transportation names.

First Earnings Report as a Public Company

Einride's inaugural earnings release as a publicly traded company showed first-half 2026 revenue of SEK 273 million (about $27 million) on a constant-currency basis, up 26% year-over-year (YoY) and roughly in line with company guidance. As a foreign private issuer, Einride currently reports semi-annually rather than quarterly, a practice it plans to change starting in 2027, meaning no formal Wall Street consensus estimate existed yet for this first release.

The company posted a net loss of SEK 1.12 billion for the first half of 2026, widening from SEK 887 million a year earlier. That wider loss was driven largely by SEK 881 million in non-cash charges, including a SEK 636 million recapitalization expense tied to the SPAC merger and a SEK 245 million share-based compensation charge stemming from the public listing. Einride ended the period with SEK 748 million (roughly $77 million) in cash. On the operational side, driverless hours logged in contracted customer operations climbed 64% to more than 5,400 hours.

Story Continues

Management guided second-half 2026 constant-currency revenue growth to accelerate sharply to 60–73% YoY, driven by fleet expansion and the conversion of roughly $800 million in long-term joint business plan potential into recognized revenue. After the quarter closed, Einride announced a landmark deal to deploy 500 Tesla Semi trucks on its Saga AI platform, effectively tripling its fleet size, alongside a new collaboration with DAF Trucks. The company is targeting cash-flow breakeven by 2028, a milestone that will likely determine whether Einride's ambitious autonomous freight vision can eventually translate into sustainable profitability.

Einride Partners With Nvidia to Power Next-Gen Autonomous Trucks

Einride is teaming up with Nvidia to power the next generation of its autonomous driving system as the Swedish freight technology company gears up to scale production and meet rising demand for driverless trucks. Under the partnership announced Monday, Nvidia will provide the computing platform and AI tools behind Einride's autonomous systems, with both companies jointly developing the next-generation Einride Driver on Nvidia's Hyperion platform.

Einride currently runs hundreds of electric trucks across the U.S., Europe, and the Middle East and expects demand to reach 1,500–2,000 vehicles by 2028, with roughly 80% potentially suited for automation. CTO Henrik Green said the deal will help Einride scale autonomous deployment across its active freight network.

Shares jumped roughly 6% in premarket trading, building on recent momentum from a growing customer roster including PepsiCo (PEP), Carlsberg (CABGY), Heineken (HEINY), and Einride's blockbuster Tesla (TSLA) Semi deal.

126% Upside on a Single Rating: What It Means for ENRD Stock

Nvidia's backing of Einride's next-generation autonomous driving system lends serious technological credibility to a stock that's been battered since its SPAC debut, signaling that a major industry heavyweight sees real long-term potential in its driverless freight platform. Wall Street coverage remains razor-thin, with just a single analyst rating on record, but that lone call is a "Strong Buy" with an $8 price target, implying a striking 126% upside from current levels.

Limited coverage warrants caution, but the Nvidia partnership and Einride's growing customer base point to speculative long-term upside for risk-tolerant investors.

news.Title: Meta’s Muse Is Dominating the App Store. What This Means for META Stock.
news.Content:
Meta (META) CEO Mark Zuckerberg may swear by Android, yet that has not stopped the company's recently launched personal AI agent Muse from reaching the No.1 position in Apple's (AAPL) App Store within a week. As concerns around AI safety gather momentum, this development from Muse is noteworthy, as the future of AI may see personal AI agents gaining prominence over general platforms.

Commenting on the development, Meta's Chief AI Officer, Alexander Wang, posting on X (formerly Twitter), said, "A week after launch, Muse is now the #1 app in the App Store! It's been SO exciting to see how much y'all have done with Muse. We can't wait to do more together!" Interestingly, the announcement was made on none of the platforms owned by Meta, but rather on X, a company under Elon Musk, with whom Zuckerberg have not had cordial relations to say the least.

More News from Barchart

SpaceX Has Huge, Unusual Put Options Volume - Is SPCX Set to Fall or Rise From Here?

Lucid Just Struck a Partnership With Bolt on Mobility. What This Means for LCID Stock.

Why It's Time to Load Up on Meta Stock

Stop Missing Market Moves: Get the FREE Barchart Brief – your midday dose of stock movers, trending sectors, and actionable trade ideas, delivered right to your inbox. Sign Up Now!

So far at least, Muse seems to have sparked META stock back to life. After an impressive 35% spike in price over the past month, the stock is now up 13% year-to-date (YTD). It is still to be seen if this rally can be sustained, as Meta has remained mired in legal quagmires this year, with the most notable being the $18 billion settlement reached with several states on child safety.

Musing on Muse

Muse's journey to the zenith in the App Store should be looked at in a larger context. The rapid climb appears to reflect a combination of product design, Meta's distribution reach, curiosity around agentic software, and strong early visibility.

The central distinction is that Muse is designed to complete tasks rather than simply answer questions. Meta says users can ask it to research a subject, book appointments, fill out forms, purchase products, generate images, create documents, set reminders, monitor information, and connect services such as email, calendars, Instagram, Spotify (SPOT), and OpenTable. It can also continue working after the user closes the application. For example, a user could ask Muse to monitor weather conditions, track a price, or organize a longer personal goal and receive an update when something changes or when approval is required. That persistent workflow is likely more attractive to the mass market than a chatbot that mainly produces text inside a conversation.

Story Continues

In fact, Business Insider reported examples of Muse users saying it helped with things such as shopping and insurance savings, while also noting that the system still has limitations. Particularly for shopping, Muse can search for products, locate discounts, add items to a shopping cart, and complete a purchase after receiving permission. Meta says checkout uses Stripe's Link service, with a one-time card number designed to conceal the user's actual payment details. Eligible purchases receive Link purchase protections covering issues such as damaged or lost goods, price reductions, and returns.

Meanwhile, enhanced privacy controls could have also been a point of attraction for users. Meta says Muse operates inside a dedicated virtual machine, while a separate Sentinel system reviews internet access and sensitive actions. Users are asked before emails are sent or purchases are made, can inspect an activity record, and can adjust permissions for each connected service. Meta also says Muse cannot see stored passwords or payment information, does not share conversations with its advertising systems, and allows users to opt out of model training.

Thus, Muse's early advantage appears to be accessibility, integration with Meta's consumer ecosystem, persistent background work, and a heightened focus on making shopping easier. Now, sustained adoption will depend on reliability, privacy confidence, and whether Muse consistently completes useful tasks without requiring excessive supervision.

Moreover, reaching No. 1 on Apple's App Store should not be interpreted as Muse overtaking established AI assistants in total users. App Store rankings primarily reflect download momentum, making the milestone more indicative of strong recent adoption than cumulative market share.

Meta's Unlikeable Q2

Meta's latest set of quarterly numbers for Q2 2026 was not liked by the Street. Shares dropped almost 10% post the results as a collapse in free cash, a decrease in operating margins, and a rise in the lower end of the capex guidance all made up a concoction that spooked investors.

However, Q2 2026 saw the company report revenues of $60.8 billion, up 28% from the previous year, as its "Family of Apps" saw a 3% yearly rise in daily active users to 3.60 billion. This is just under half the world population. And despite AI being the primary focus of the company, ad revenues remain vital for the company (97.6% of overall revenues at $59.4 billion), and a 12% year-over-year (YoY) increase in average price per ad would be welcomed.

Meanwhile, earnings slid by 13% from the previous year to $6.18 per share, missing the consensus estimate of $7.40 per share by a wide margin. A 55% increase in costs and expenses to $42.02 billion and an even sharper bump of 82.7% in capital expenditures to $31.08 billion were the contributing factors to the decline in profits. Moreover, Meta raised the lower end of its capex guidance to $130 billion from $125 billion, keeping the upper range unchanged at $145 billion.

Q3 revenue estimates range between $61 and $64 billion, with the Street estimates standing at $63.31 billion.

Coming back to Q2, net cash from operating activities for the quarter came in at $31.9 billion, up from $25.6 billion in the year-ago period. Overall, Meta ended the quarter with a cash balance of $15.5 billion, much higher than its short-term debt levels of $2.43 billion. On the other hand, free cash flow tumbled to $784 million from a mammoth $8.55 billion a year ago, putting more pressure on the huge AI capex of the company to pay off.

Valuation comfort is also not there for META, as the stock's forward P/E, P/S, and P/CF of 21.34, 6.67, and 12.71 are all above the sector medians of 12.98, 1.15, and 7.36, respectively.

Analyst Opinion on META Stock

Wall Street remains upbeat about META stock, though, giving it a consensus "Strong Buy" rating. The mean target price of $761.38 indicates a potential upside of 2% from current levels. Out of 54 analysts covering the stock, 45 have a "Strong Buy" rating, two have a "Moderate Buy" rating, and seven have a "Hold" rating.

news.Title: Can Apple Overtake NVIDIA as the World's Most Valuable Company?
news.Content:
Key Points

Interested in Apple Inc.? Here are five stocks we like better.

Apple's market cap has climbed to about $4.98 trillion, closing in on NVIDIA's roughly $5.50 trillion valuation amid a strong iPhone launch.

NVIDIA's stock has stalled since May due to investor caution over AI spending sustainability, export risks, and margins, despite still-strong underlying growth.

NVIDIA's revenue is growing more than 80% annually versus Apple's 14%, suggesting any Apple overtake in market cap could prove short-lived.

For most of the past two years, NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ: NVDA) has stood at the summit of the stock market. As the chipmaker whose processors power much of the artificial intelligence boom, it was perhaps no surprise that it became the first company ever to reach a $5 trillion market cap. After first hitting that record in October 2025, it has spent much of 2026 comfortably above the mark.

Yet its perch has not gone unchallenged. In July of this past summer, Apple Inc. (NASDAQ: AAPL) briefly leapfrogged it, closing in on the $5 trillion milestone before NVIDIA reclaimed the top spot. Now, the iPhone maker is closing the gap once more. Its shares are up about 6% since the first week of September to roughly $4.98 trillion, while NVIDIA, down about 1.6% over the same stretch, has stalled at around $5.50 trillion.

→ NVIDIA Just Named AI's Next Bottleneck—And These 3 Stocks Sit Right In It

For companies this size, that's close enough to make another overtake a real possibility in the coming weeks. The question is no longer whether Apple can catch NVIDIA, but whether it can stay ahead once it does.

How the Race Has Tightened

The shift in momentum has been steady rather than sudden, with Apple outpacing NVIDIA for much of the past 12 months. Since this time last year, for example, Apple's shares have climbed around 32%, comfortably outpacing NVIDIA's 24%. Since early August, Apple has rallied roughly 11% while NVIDIA has managed barely 1%.

→ These 3 AI Stocks Sold Off Hard—Even as Their Outlooks Improved

Recently, Apple's uptrend has come from a clear catalyst. Its Sept. 9 product launch, headlined by a new lineup of premium iPhones and its first-ever foldable model, generated both pre-release hype and post-release results. Early demand signals have been encouraging, and analysts have continued to warm to the story, with some, like TD Cowen, already lifting their price target to $400 this month.

NVIDIA's plateau, by contrast, seems to be less about its business faltering and more about nerves. Its growth remains phenomenal, but investors have grown more cautious about how long the frenzied AI-infrastructure spending can last, and about risks ranging from thinning margins to Chinese export restrictions. As a result, the stock hasn't hit a fresh all-time high since May.

Story Continues

→ Oil Tanker Rates Top $1 Million a Day—3 Ways Investors Can Trade the Surge

What Would Get Apple Over the Line

To match NVIDIA's current market cap, Apple's shares would need to rise only around 11%, a move it has already managed once since early August. Given how the two have diverged lately, a continued rally in Apple, paired with more of NVIDIA's recent drift, could mean the gap closes within a matter of weeks.

The most likely fuel would be further evidence that the new iPhones are flying off the shelves. If demand for the latest premium models proves as strong as the early indicators suggest, and the foldable carves out a lucrative new niche, the rally should have the legs to keep going. Investors won't have to wait long for a read on that, with Apple's next earnings report due at the end of October and set to reveal whether the early enthusiasm is showing up in the numbers.

Why It's Far From a Done Deal

Yet for all Apple's momentum, the underlying numbers still favor the incumbent, and this is the crucial caveat. NVIDIA may have smaller share-price gains lately, but its business is growing at a blistering pace, with revenue expanding more than 80% over the past year versus Apple's far more reserved 14%.

That difference matters enormously, and it explains why NVIDIA commands the larger valuation in the first place: investors are happy to pay for far faster growth. For Apple to not just catch NVIDIA but stay ahead, it would need to sustain its rally in the face of a rival still expanding several times quicker, no simple task.

Apple's own path carries risks, too. The foldable market remains small, and its aggressive pricing could deter some buyers. If the iPhone cycle disappoints, or enthusiasm fades, the recent surge could stall as quickly as it began.

Does the Top Spot Even Matter?

So is Apple about to reclaim the top spot? Based on current trends, it is tantalizingly close, and if its rally holds while NVIDIA continues to drift, the overtake could happen in the weeks ahead. For now, momentum is firmly with the iPhone maker.

However, investors should be wary of reading too much into a market-cap milestone. Being the world's most valuable company is a headline, not a verdict on which stock is the better buy, and NVIDIA's faster growth means that any lead Apple seizes could prove short-lived.

For now, the race is remarkably close, and a symbolic changing of the guard may be near. Whether it proves lasting, though, will come down to the far less glamorous business of who can actually keep growing. Apple has the momentum, NVIDIA has the numbers, and the coming weeks will show which matters more.

news.Title: Tesla’s Delivery Warning Barely Moved the Stock—Here’s What Investors Care About
news.Content:
Key Points

Interested in Tesla, Inc.? Here are five stocks we like better.

Goldman Sachs cut its Tesla third-quarter delivery forecast to 435,000 vehicles from 490,000, yet the stock barely reacted and remains near recent highs.

Investors increasingly value Tesla on its autonomous driving, robotaxi, and Optimus robot ambitions rather than on how many cars it actually delivers each quarter.

Bears warn that ignoring weak deliveries is risky because the car business funds Tesla's futuristic ventures and its slowdown could undermine the company's broader growth narrative.

Not long ago, a cut to Tesla Inc.'s (NASDAQ: TSLA) delivery forecast from a name as influential as Goldman Sachs would have sent the shares sliding. On Sept. 15, 2026, Goldman did exactly that, slashing its estimate for the electric-car maker's third-quarter deliveries, yet the stock barely blinked. Tesla shares remain near recent highs despite Goldman's cut to its forecast.

That muted reaction says everything about where Tesla now finds itself. Once judged, like any carmaker, on how many vehicles it sells, the company is increasingly valued on a wholly different promise: that it will lead the world into an age of self-driving cars, humanoid robots, and artificial intelligence. The cars, in the market's eyes, have become almost a sideshow.

→ NVIDIA Just Named AI's Next Bottleneck—And These 3 Stocks Sit Right In It

That said, the broader picture isn't exactly rosy. Tesla's stock remains stuck in a multi-month downtrend, regulatory pressure over the Cybercab is mounting, and the company's next earnings report is due in just over a month. Goldman's downgrade, then, lands at an already delicate moment, which makes the market's indifference to it all the more telling.

Goldman Turns More Cautious on Tesla Deliveries

The bank's update was hardly trivial. Goldman cut its forecast for third-quarter deliveries to 435,000 vehicles, down from 490,000, and trimmed its fourth-quarter number too, blaming softer sales across Tesla's three most important markets: China, the United States, and Europe.

→ These 3 AI Stocks Sold Off Hard—Even as Their Outlooks Improved

The near-term picture it paints is far from rosy. Goldman's new third-quarter estimate sits below the wider consensus, and Tesla faces a punishing comparison with the same period last year, when a record number of buyers rushed to beat the expiry of a generous tax credit. And, with two of its models recently discontinued, the lineup doing the heavy lifting is thinner than before.

Story Continues

There is a glimmer of hope, though, for those bulls still counting on Tesla's delivery numbers. Goldman's fourth-quarter forecast, while lowered, still sits above the broader consensus, hinting that the firm sees the current softness as temporary. The coming months will test whether this is a passing dip or something more stubborn.

→ Oil Tanker Rates Top $1 Million a Day—3 Ways Investors Can Trade the Surge

Why Deliveries No Longer Drive the Entire Thesis

However, for all the significance a lowered delivery forecast like this would have for a normal carmaker, Tesla has spent years persuading investors it's anything but. Its towering valuation, with shares trading at nearly 350 times earnings, cannot be justified by selling cars alone. It only makes sense if you believe in the far larger prizes management keeps dangling.

Those prizes are well known by now: the robotaxi dream embodied by the recently launched Cybercab, self-driving software sold to millions of existing owners, and the humanoid Optimus robot that Elon Musk insists could one day dwarf the car business entirely. There is even talk of a possible merger with Musk's rocket venture SpaceX, a deal some believe could re-rate the stock on its own. Next to ambitions like these, whether Tesla delivers 435,000 cars or 490,000 in a quarter can almost feel beside the point.

That's why the stock has seemingly shrugged off Goldman's downward revision. Those investors buying Tesla at this price are, by and large, not buying a carmaker. They're buying a bet on an autonomous, AI-powered future, and no single quarter's delivery figure is going to make or break that thesis.

The Danger in Ignoring Deliveries Altogether

That said, it would be a mistake to dismiss the delivery numbers entirely, and here the bears have a point. However exciting the future may be, the car business remains Tesla's only large, proven source of revenue, the engine that funds every one of those futuristic ventures. Should it stall or start sliding, Tesla's whole story suddenly looks a lot less secure.

There's the credibility question, too. Tesla's autonomy story rests on the idea that it's a company already racing ahead of its rivals, so any weakness like this in its core business risks undermining the very narrative the bulls rely on. A carmaker struggling to grow doesn't sound like the kind of business that could become the future of transport, no matter how clever its technology.

The robotaxi dream, meanwhile, carries plenty of risk of its own. The Cybercab faces a live regulatory challenge; its rollout is dwarfed by rivals like Alphabet's (NASDAQ: GOOGL) Waymo, and it may contribute next to nothing to the top line for years yet. For now, the grand vision is still just a vision.

Tesla's Bigger Story Still Has to Deliver

So do deliveries matter? The honest answer is both yes and no. In the short term, the market has clearly decided they don't, and a soft third quarter alone is unlikely to move the shares much. Tesla is, for now, continuing to transcend the ordinary rules of the car business.

But that's a double-edged sword. A stock priced almost entirely on a future that has yet to arrive rests on faith, and faith won't last forever if the promised breakthroughs keep slipping over the horizon. The deliveries may not matter today, but a business whose main revenue engine stalls can only coast on future promise for so long.

news.Title: AMD Just Joined the $1 Trillion Club. Here's Why Investors Are Betting Big on the Chipmaker.
news.Content:
Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD) hit a major milestone on Sept. 21, surpassing the $1 trillion market capitalization mark. AMD becomes the fourth chipmaker in the rarefied club, joining Nvidia , Broadcom , and Micron Technology .

AMD shares have been on a huge run, jumping 187% so far this year and 23% in the last week as the semiconductor sector rebounds. And while the company has long toiled in Nvidia's formidable shadow, investors are finding plenty to like about the company and its role in the growth of artificial intelligence.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 15x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Image source: AMD.

What does Advanced Micro Devices do?

AMD, as it's called, is much more than a Nvidia competitor. The California-based company makes a wide range of high-performance processors, including graphics processing units (GPUs) and central processing units (CPUs), with widespread applications in personal computers, gaming devices, and, of course, data centers .

And it's the data center business that is helping AMD soar to new heights. Data center revenue in the second quarter was $6.7 billion, up 107% from a year ago. Management attributed the gains to strong demand for the company's EPYC server CPUs and its Instinct GPUs.

On top of that, AMD offers its Helios fully integrated, rack-scale AI systems that operate on 72 Instinct accelerators and 18 EPYC CPUs.

"We enter the second half with strong momentum as EPYC demand accelerates, Instinct deployments scale, and Helios begins to ramp," CEO Lisa Su said. "More broadly, AI is driving a significant expansion in demand for compute across all of our markets, and our leadership portfolio and growing customer visibility position us exceptionally well to capture this expanding opportunity and deliver substantial revenue and earnings growth in the years ahead."

AMD says major AI companies, including ﻿ Meta Platforms , Microsoft , Oracle , OpenAI, and Anthropic, are already using the Helios system.

The numbers help tell the story

AMD doesn't reach Nvidia's sales level, but it's ramping up quickly. Overall revenue in Q2 was $11.53 billion, up 50% from a year ago. The company had net income of $2.29 billion, up 163%, and diluted earnings per share of $1.38, up 156% from last year.

Just as importantly, AMD's profit margin is growing. Gross margins in Q2 were 54%, up from 40% in the same period a year ago. Management says it expects data center revenue to accelerate further in the second half of the year, allowing earnings to expand.

Story Continues

The fourth member of an impressive club

Achieving a $1 trillion market cap is rare -- fewer than 20 companies in the world have made that lofty mark. But it's no coincidence that chip companies are well-represented in the club.

Nvidia, with its leading position in GPUs and high-level processors, has become the most valuable company in the world. Broadcom's custom-made processors designed for specific customers and workloads have gained in popularity, and Micron gained even more than AMD so far this year, as its storage, including its data storage chips and computer memory products, is in as much demand as processors.

AMD data by YCharts

And it appears that AMD is just getting started. OpenAI and Meta Platforms have both committed to multiyear agreements with AMD, each planning to deploy up to 6 gigawatts of AMD GPUs. The agreements signal that big tech companies recognize AMD as a larger supplier for AI. That helps explain why the stock price has increased nearly three times as much as AMD's revenue in the last year -- investors are willing to pay more for AMD's anticipated future earnings.

The $1 trillion valuation is a milestone that reflects the market's lofty expectations.

news.Title: The Lever That Could Take Intel Stock to $165 Per Share, According to Wall Street
news.Content:
Intel (INTC) is entering a potentially important phase of its transformation, with its manufacturing ambitions emerging as a key source of investor interest. As the company expands its foundry capabilities and explores new strategic relationships, Wall Street is increasingly focused on whether these efforts could unlock value beyond Intel's existing operations.

That optimism was reflected in INTC stock, which climbed 7.7% on Thursday, Sept. 17, following several analyst upgrades and growing enthusiasm around Intel's manufacturing strategy. Reports that SK hynix (SKHY) is exploring memory-chip production at Intel's Ohio facility, either directly or through a joint venture involving major cloud providers, added another potential catalyst to the story.

More News from Barchart

SpaceX Has Huge, Unusual Put Options Volume - Is SPCX Set to Fall or Rise From Here?

Lucid Just Struck a Partnership With Bolt on Mobility. What This Means for LCID Stock.

Why It's Time to Load Up on Meta Stock

Tired of missing midday reversals? The FREE Barchart Brief newsletter keeps you in the know. Sign up now!

Among the analysts turning more constructive is Ben Reitzes of Melius Research, who has reiterated a "Buy" rating and a $165 price target on INTC stock. His thesis rests largely on the potential value of Intel's foundry business, which he believes could eventually be separated around 2030 and operate as a standalone U.S. semiconductor manufacturer.

Reitzes estimates Intel's foundry and product businesses could each ultimately be worth more than $80 per share, creating the foundation for his $165 valuation thesis. Intel's planned increase in 2027 capital spending, including investment in its next-generation 14A process, further reinforces the company's commitment to its manufacturing roadmap.

However, there is more to the story. Let's take a closer look.

About Intel Stock

Headquartered in Santa Clara, California, Intel is a global semiconductor and technology company that designs and manufactures processors, graphics, networking, artificial intelligence (AI), and connectivity products.

With a market cap of roughly $547.8 billion, it also provides data center and computing solutions, foundry services, automotive technologies, and semiconductor manufacturing tools.

On the price performance front, INTC stock surged 255.3% over the past 52 weeks. The momentum has carried into 2026, with shares climbing 194.3% year-to-date (YTD), followed by another 12.3% jump during the last month alone.

On the valuation front, investors are pricing the stock at a premium. The stock is trading at 71.44 times forward-adjusted earnings and 9.05 times sales, placing both multiples well above industry benchmarks and the stock's own five-year average.

Story Continues

Intel Surpasses Q2 Earnings

On July 23, Intel reported its Q2 FY2026 financial results, marking the seventh consecutive quarter in which it exceeded management's financial expectations. Revenue grew 25.4% YOY to $16.13 billion, beating analyst estimates of $14.43 billion. It was the company's strongest growth in 15 years.

Looking at individual segments, Client Computing revenue rose 13% YOY to $8.9 billion as the client TAM continued to hold up well despite broad component constraints and price inflation. Meanwhile, DCAI revenue surged 59% YOY to $6.3 billion, supported by strong demand across hyperscale and enterprise customers.

Intel Foundry also delivered meaningful growth, generating $5.8 billion in revenue, up 31% YOY. Profitability improved alongside the revenue gains. Non-GAAP gross margin reached 41.8%, approximately 280 basis points better than guidance, while non-GAAP net income came in at $2.2 billion versus a non-GAAP net loss of $441 million in the prior year's period.

Furthermore, adjusted EPS amounted to $0.42, also largely surpassing Street expectations of $0.22. Cash generation provided another positive signal. Q2 operating cash flow reached $7 billion, while Intel exited the quarter with a strong liquidity position, including approximately $30 billion in cash and short-term investments.

For Q3 2026, Intel has guided revenue of $15.8 billion to $16.8 billion, adjusted EPS of $0.38, and a non-GAAP gross margin of approximately 42%. Turning to CapEx, strong customer demand signals have prompted the company to raise its 2026 outlook, with CapEx now expected to exceed $20 billion.

The guidance remains anchored in persistent demand for AI compute and ongoing infrastructure buildouts. Intel believes this demand will outpace the industry's supply capacity in the near term, creating an important opportunity across its operations.

Meanwhile, analysts anticipate Q3 EPS to increase by 154.6% YOY to $0.28. For FY2026, earnings are expected to soar by 966.7% YOY to $1.04. Additionally, analysts project FY2027 EPS to grow 38.5% from the previous year to $1.44.

What Do Analysts Expect for Intel Stock?

Reitzes is not the only analyst taking a constructive view of Intel. Northland upgraded the stock to "Outperform" with a $120 price target, citing clear progress in the company's turnaround. Tigress Financial also raised its price target on Intel to $145 from $118 while maintaining a "Buy" rating.

Wall Street has given INTC stock an overall "Moderate Buy" rating. Among 46 analysts covering the company, 12 rate the shares a "Strong Buy," one assigns a "Moderate Buy," 31 stick with "Hold," while two call for a "Strong Sell."

To that end, Intel's average analyst price target of $114.58 represents potential upside of 5.5%, while the Street-High target of $200 suggests a gain of 84.2% from current levels.

news.Title: 近5年Q4主要股市 台股均漲逾7%冠全球
news.Content:
【記者柯安聰台北報導】過完中秋假期後，時序也將進入第4季，第4季在節慶效應加持下，向來為全球傳統消費旺季，過往經驗來看股市表現亦多不俗。統計近5年全球主要股市於第4季平均表現，整體來看漲多跌少，前10強股市平均都有超過3%的表現，當中又以台股表現最佳，加權指數平均漲幅近7.67%，緊接著為美股，S&P500指數上漲6.68%亦是亮眼，其他包括日本、法國、南韓等也有好於4%的漲幅，投資人不妨善用相關ETF或基金加以布局，把握投資契機。

主動群益核心50(00415A)經理人許育誌表示，聯準會於最新FOMC會議中決議升息1碼，結束2024年9月以來的降息循環，決策符合市場預期，市場焦點也料重回基本面評估，基本面佳的區域與產業仍足以抵禦利率上行風險。鑒於台灣經濟保持穩健，加上AI需求強勁，尤其在企業資本支出持續投資，以及相關應用持續落地下，長期發展明確，台系供應鏈因在當中扮演關鍵技術與零組件生產要角，仍有望持續受惠，故對於台股後市仍正向看待。

群益S&P500(009823)經理人謝明志指出，美國經濟活動持續以穩健步調擴張。儘管地緣政治情勢等因素使經濟前景仍籠罩高度不確定性，但國內支出保持韌性，生產力成長強勁，企業獲利前景仍佳，獲利預估上修的企業範圍持續擴大，顯示基本面與獲利面仍能支持美股表現，而在美股題材多元、資金於各類股間健康輪動下，建議投資人不妨善用廣泛布局各產業的市值型美股ETF來參與行情。其中追蹤標普500指數因成分股組成廣泛，涵蓋近9成的美股總市值，布局追蹤該指數的美股ETF形同於布局全產業美股，全方位掌握美股行情。

群益東方盛世基金經理人洪玉婷表示，日本企業獲利展現韌性，排除關稅退還與匯率等一次性因素後，今年4月至6月企業獲利年增約9.3%，銀行受惠於升息、非鐵金屬受惠原物料上漲，AI概念股則受惠AI需求強勁，故市場預期FY26日本企業獲利可望成長近19%，此外，日本企業股票回購金額已達2025年全年水準，企業亦持續透過出售交叉持股、提高股利與回購強化股東回饋，外資亦具備回補空間，故在獲利面與資金面都屬正向，且經濟持穩，皆有助於日股表現。（自立電子報2026/9/22）

news.Title: 信驊登首檔「兩萬金」！台股創高後收全日最低　小漲81點、636檔個股下跌
news.Content:
台股今（22）日大洗三溫暖，早盤受美股強勢與上櫃新股掛牌首日大漲帶動，開盤即站上4萬8千點大關，並一路衝上最高48601.53點，改寫歷史新高，然而，賣壓隨即湧現，大盤一路走低，終場收在全日最低47,800.17點，僅微幅上漲81.33點或0.17%，但仍寫下6月以來收盤新高，全日振幅801.36點。

市場交易熱度顯著放量，今日成交金額攀升至1,0723.88億元，較前一交易日增加23.72%，亦高於9月日均量逾兩成。

台積電開高翻黑　信驊晉升首檔「2萬金股」

觀察個股表現，權值股部分，權王台積電（2330）早盤最高達2510元、漲30元，終場翻黑收在2460元、跌20元；聯發科（2454）漲170元或3.39%；台達電（2308）漲25元或1.33%；鴻海（2317）漲3塊或1.20%；日月光控股（3711）漲30元或4.52%。

高價股部分，股王信驊（5274）大漲1085元、5.47%，股價來到20905元，成為台股史上首檔「兩萬金股」；川湖（2059）則跌130元或1.02%；千金股創意（3443）鎖漲停價8375元，再創新高，力旺（3529）也收在漲停板3110元，嘉澤（3533）、高力（8996）等千金股亦衝高漲停。

ABF載板三雄南電（8046）、欣興（3037）、景碩(3189)也齊攻漲停；此外，上櫃新兵漢測（7856）強勢襲來，首日飆漲110.22%，股價來到4730元。

指數漲、個股跌　逾6成個股收黑

然而，全場僅330檔上漲，多達636檔下跌，上漲家數僅占30.58%。盤面紅盤主要集中於部分中大型權值股。例如臺灣50權重上限30%指數上漲0.66%，表現優於中小型股指數。

電子類股亦出現「指數漲、個股跌」現象。電子零組件類指數雖上漲2.20%，但103檔成分股中有57檔下跌；光電類指數上漲1.18%，也有45檔下跌；電機機械類指數上漲1.04%，47檔中僅7檔 上漲；半導體類指數則微漲0.08%。

三大法人買超608億 外資現貨買超期貨加空

籌碼面方面，三大法人今日合計買超608.21億元。其中外資買超447.27億元，自營商買超158.54億元，投信買超2.40億元。

外資已連續4個交易日買超台股現貨，累計買超達1,643.85億元。不過，外資在期貨市場呈現對沖避險動作。台指期外資空方未平倉量增至86,308口，淨空單擴大至75,568口，出現現貨承接與期貨加空同時發生的形勢。

長假與季底調節賣壓 法人建議逢低布局

技術面，目前加權指數仍維持在月線之上、正乖離2.71%，及季線之上、正乖離5.59%。

永豐投顧表示，全日成交量沒有特別放大，意味短線只是搶短，多頭氣勢後續還有發揮空間。近期美股表現強勁，帶動台股持續往上攻，然而，中秋長假將至與季底調節影響，見高後易出現高檔震盪行情，建議投資人採長期投資策略，逢低布局。

news.Title: 台股多頭旺盛 鎖定中小股本主動式ETF問世
news.Content:
[ 非凡新聞 ]記者周恬吏,攝影邱文傑

台股多頭氣勢不減，國內投信看好AI資本支出，逐步轉化為企業獲利，預估第四季到2027年行情仍有支撐。且隨大型股漲多，資金開始尋找中小型股的投資機會，順勢推出聚焦中小股本的台股主動式ETF。歷史數據顯示，美國期中選舉後一年，台股中小型股，平均報酬達22%，優於大型股的15%，也讓市場開始找尋下一波AI成長黑馬。

美伊還在角力，國際變數仍多，但台股是一路攻高，權值股撐起了大盤半邊天。當指數站上高檔，市場目光開始從大型權值股，轉向更具獲利爆發力的中小型股。且以獲利基本面與歷史數據來看，國內投信仍然相當看好第四季，到2027年台股大行情。

台新投信投資長 趙志中：「我覺得最主要就是剛提到資本支出，它已經轉換成這個企業的變現能力，那會形成一個很好的正面循環。那根據這個摩根士丹利的預估，今年標普500的AI企業，它的企業獲利年增率高達三成，那明年的話，甚至挑戰四成到五成。」

觀察美國過去五次期中選舉，前一個月底進場台股，股本80億元以下的中小型股，選後三個月平均報酬12%，6個月進一步拉高到20%，一年平均報酬更來到22%。同期大型股平均報酬，則分別只有10%、12%以及15%，三個觀察期間，中小型股的表現更勝一籌。

看準資金輪動機會，國內投信推出的ETF 00416A，鎖定股本80億元以下中小型企業，因為成長彈性就藏在「小股本」中。好比同樣新增1億元淨利，10億股本的EPS成長率，就是100億股本的10倍。

台新臺灣中小主動式ETF基金經理人 沈建宏：「第一個企業股價評價已經高了，指數已經高了，且獲利成長也到了高基期，所以個股表現就會優於大盤的表現。主要是我們會更重視，企業獲利的成長性，那小股本的公司就有企業獲利高成長的優勢，加上籌碼的優勢，所以我們認為說2027年，是中小型股會很有表現的一年。」

整體來看，AI浪潮持續擴張，高盛證券預估AI算力需求，每年以約400%的速度成長。台股企業獲利2026到2027年，年增率也都有望超過兩成，科技巨頭大手筆砸下資本支出，正要逐步轉化成實際獲利。

第四季資金重新洗牌，短線漲多，震盪難免。誰能把AI商機真正變現，才能成為2027年台股多頭行情中的強勢黑馬！（記者周恬吏、邱文傑／台北報導）

news.Title: 儀表板明上線 證交所：從數字看台股結構大不同
news.Content:
「台股儀表板」明天23日正式上線。證交所今天(22日)指出，儀表板更重要的功能是協助投資人從數字觀察股市長期結構變遷。以市場經常討論的信用交易為例，今年截至8月，信用交易成交值約占市場總成交值6%，相較2000年曾超過40%，占比已大幅下降。從此數據解析，經過20多年發展，台股市場交易結構已經出現明顯變化。

證交所表示，今年以來台股指數及成交量值都有明顯成長，市場對於融資、擔保維持率、違約等相關數據的關注度隨之提高。市場上的數據很多，但不同數據的定義、比較基礎及代表意義並不完全相同，因此，讓投資人從片段資訊解讀市場，不如把重要的數據集中呈現，讓數據自己說話。

證交所也指出，「台灣儀表板」首波上線內容包括3大面向。一是證券商授信業務，除市場近期關注的「全市場擔保維持率」外，也包括追繳處分戶數及金額、融資餘額、信用交易成交值，以及不限用途款項借貸、借券及借券賣出等交易業務資訊。二是投資人違約概況，提供違約總人數、違約買進賣出合計總金額，以及個別證券達違約資訊揭露標準等資訊。三是上市櫃公司營收，提供全體上市櫃公司單月及累計營收、月增率及年增率，並呈現各產業營收成長、衰退情形與最近1年趨勢。台股儀表板讓投資人隨時擁有充分資訊以判讀股市全貌，降低因資訊不對稱所引發的不理性揣測或被不實數據誤導的可能性。

證交所也指出，儀表板更重要的功能是協助投資人從數字觀察股市長期結構變遷。以市場經常討論的信用交易為例，今年截至8月，信用交易成交值約占市場總成交值6%，相較2000年曾超過40%，占比已大幅下降。從這項數據可以看到，經過20多年發展，台股市場交易結構已經出現明顯變化。因此，判讀股票市場風險時，不能只看到融資餘額等單一數字增加，就直接與過去市場情況相比；還應同時觀察市場整體規模、成交值、占比及長期趨勢，才能更完整理解數字背後代表的涵義。

在資料更新方面，證交所也表示，儀表板的交易類資訊每日更新，隔日即可查詢前一交易日資料，圖表預設呈現最近5個交易日資訊；上市櫃公司營收資訊則按月更新。投資人也可依上市、上櫃及全市場等不同角度查看相關資訊，大幅減少自行跨平台蒐集、彙整及比對資料所需時間。

證交所強調，「台股儀表板」9月23日上線只是第一步，未來將持續觀察市場發展及投資人需求，逐步充實指標及功能，讓儀表板成為投資人觀察台股的重要且友善的資訊入口，持續為台股市場挹注更多正向力量。證交所希望透過正確、透明、易懂的儀表板介面，讓投資人更全面掌握市場真實樣貌，減少因片面資訊或市場傳言造成的誤解，讓投資判斷回歸數據與理性。(編輯：宋皖媛)

news.Title: 不是聊天機器人，而是真正的「AI助理」！Meta Muse全美爆紅　阮慕驊曝台股有福了：受惠範圍更廣
news.Content: Meta 近日在美加推出個人AI代理App「 Muse 」上線後在美國迅速爆紅，帶動Meta股價大漲。（資料照，美聯社） Meta近日在美加推出個人AI代理App「Muse」，其定位並非單純回答問題的聊天機器人，而是能代替使用者執行多步驟任務，上線後在美國迅速爆紅，帶動Meta股價大漲。對此，財經專家 阮慕驊 指出，Meta Muse「從聊天到代辦」讓AI算力需求再升級，需求從GPU擴散到CPU等其他供應鏈，將真正牽動到台股，「受惠範圍比上一波AI行情更廣」。 阮慕驊表示，Meta最近推出的Muse，是AI從「回答問題」走向「替人做事」的關鍵產品，全球除美國和加拿大外，還無法下載。 ​Meta Muse能做什麼？​ 阮慕驊提到，什麼是Muse？它會開啟瀏覽器、填寫表單、代使用者議價；關閉App後仍在背景持續執行，在寄信或購物等需要授權時才回頭詢問。它也可以直接在WhatsApp裡使用，對數十億Meta用戶來說，幾乎沒有學習門檻。 阮慕驊指出，市場反應相當直接，Muse已連續3天是美國iPhone下載量最高的免費App，Meta股價周一大漲11.4%，是2025年4月以來最強的單日表現。 ​Muse只在美加上市，也能牽動台股？​ 阮慕驊分析，而Muse已真正牽動台股的，是算力結構的變化。彭博分析指出，大量AI代理同時執行任務時，需要CPU負責管理和調度，CPU因此成為市場焦點；而Meta不綁定單一晶片供應商，有助漲勢擴散到更多半導體業者。 阮慕驊表示，美股方面，Intel周一漲11.22%、Arm漲11.93%；台股今天同步反映，加權指數早盤最高來到48601點，突破前高48218點；聯發科盤中大漲逾8%、日月光投控漲幅超過6%、股王信驊一度漲停，創21800元新天價。

news.Title: 面板設備跨半導體! 均豪成CoWoS.CoPoS供鏈
news.Content:
[ 非凡新聞 ]

AI晶片持續往高算力、大尺寸發展，也帶動先進封裝技術加速升級，過去面板產業累積的大尺寸製程、玻璃技術與設備整合能力，如今也開始跨進半導體。其中，面板設備大廠均豪，已經是先進封裝重要供應鏈之一，目前在手訂單已經排到2027年。另一方面，面板雙虎友達、群創，也積極布局玻璃基板等新技術。今（22）日友達股價更是亮燈漲停。

從慘業到AI新戰場，過去的面板設備大廠均豪，如今也華麗轉身，搶進AI先進封裝。一路從面板跨到半導體，現在更成為CoWoS、CoPoS重要供應鏈之一。

均豪科技董事長 陳政興：「確實現在在手訂單都已經是排到2027年。事實上，你從台積電的資本支出的調升，他調升到大概640億，日月光投控的資本支出，大概也上調到105億美金。我想這裡面就說，整個台灣這幾個主要的龍頭企業，事實上在帶領整個產業投資，所以對於設備廠商，應該都是後面的需求，應該都是我認為是相當樂觀。」

均豪董事長陳政興樂觀的理由，是跟隨著台積電CoPoS的目標，將基板尺寸放大到310×310，相關供應鏈也全力配合2027試產、2028年量產的目標。同時面板雙虎友達、群創，也積極搶進半導體新商機。

均豪強攻先進封裝設備；友達布局玻璃基板、玻璃穿孔技術；群創則切入扇出型面板級封裝。一個個新技術，都成了投資人關注焦點。這些都是過去一點一滴的累積。

均豪科技董事長 陳政興：「我們早期像均豪、東捷，以前都是著墨在面板業。因為以前在面板業，我們以前就是號稱『北均豪、南東捷』，所以以前在面板行業，我們都累積培養非常非常多的工程能量，剛好這個時候，剛好就可以把這些工程能量做有效地轉移，轉到半導體。」

從設備端到製造端，包括面板大尺寸製程、玻璃基板以及相關整合能力，就看「面板技術」能不能成為台灣搶進下一代AI封裝的另一張王牌。（記者朱月英、姚尹哲／新竹採訪報導）

news.Title: 金管會宣布 台股儀表板明上線 3大關鍵數據一次看
news.Content:
台股今（22）日再創4萬8601點歷史新高，市場交易熱絡之際，金管會宣布全新「台股儀表板」將於明（23）日正式上線，證交所與櫃買中心官網同步提供服務。未來投資人不用再從大量表格中逐一搜尋，可透過視覺化介面快速掌握市場交易動態、潛在風險及上市櫃公司營運趨勢。

3大面向一次掌握　融資風險、違約數據全都露

證期局副局長黃仲豪表示，「台股儀表板」定位為一站式數據觀測介面，首波優先整合「授信業務」、「違約概況」及「上市櫃公司營收」3大面向。其中授信業務包括信用交易擔保維持率、追繳及處分戶數與金額，以及不限用途款項借貸融通餘額、擔保維持率等資訊；違約概況則揭示全市場違約總人數，讓投資人能更直觀掌握市場信用風險變化。

此外，儀表板也將呈現上市櫃公司營收變化及產業別趨勢，讓投資人從市場交易與企業基本面兩個角度，掌握近期台股整體動態。

告別冷冰冰表格　最近5日走勢一眼看懂

在操作介面方面，「台股儀表板」改採清晰直觀的視覺化圖表呈現，預設顯示最近5個交易日的動態走勢，並提供歷史資料查詢功能，方便投資人進一步比對市場變化。部分指標另會加註定義說明及風險警語，降低一般投資人理解數據的門檻。

金管會表示，資本市場監理的重要原則為「安全、透明、公平」，推出儀表板是為讓投資人取得更完整、正確且即時的市場資訊，並透過客觀數據強化投資風險控管。金管會也將責成證交所及櫃買中心持續研議擴充功能與指標，並視市場需求滾動檢討調整。

（封面圖／東森新聞）

news.Title: 台股創高股民卻無感！逾千檔個股收黑 分析師拆「中秋變盤」真假
news.Content:
台股今（22）日上演雲霄飛車行情，早盤一舉突破前波高點、刷新歷史紀錄，午後卻幾乎吐回所有漲幅，日K留下明顯長上影線，也讓「創高後是否變盤」再度成為市場焦點。

加權指數今日開盤47,981.04點，盤中最高衝上48,601.53點、大漲882.69點，終場卻收在47,800.17點，只漲81.33點，從最高點回落逾801點；成交金額達1兆215.69億元。台積電(2330)也由盤中最高2,510元翻黑，終場收2,460元、下跌20元。

指數創高卻逾千檔個股跌

即使指數仍創下歷史收盤新高，個股感受卻未同步，全市場下跌個股更逾1,100檔。聯發科(2454)、聯電(2303)、友達(2409)、南電(8046)等仍有買盤，但南亞科(2408)、緯創(3231)、旺矽(6223)等則相對疲弱。

分析師張貽程認為，長假前已有獲利的投資人先調節並不意外，但「節氣變盤」不應直接等同趨勢反轉；蔡慶龍則認為，指數創高後同時出現前波套牢賣壓與低檔獲利了結，留下長上影線並非完全出乎預期。

江國中則把短、中長線拆開觀察，認為連日急漲後短線已有過熱跡象，後續要看重要支撐能否守穩，以及AI主線是正常輪動還是同步轉弱；謝晨彥也認為，若後續回測先前突破區、量能適度降溫，反而有助行情重新整理籌碼。

法人買608億 長上影線更添玄機

法人籌碼反而出現更大反差，指數從高點急墜逾800點的同一天，三大法人現貨卻同步站在買方。22日三大法人合計買超608.2億元，其中外資及陸資買超447.26億元、自營商買超158.54億元，投信也小幅買超2.4億元。

分析師認為，短線急漲後的獲利調節、長假前降部位，以及權值股高檔震盪，都可能讓指數波動放大。後續若要判斷創高行情是否降溫，仍要觀察AI、高價股與電子權值股是否維持輪動等基本面，以及成交量放大後能否出現新的承接買盤。

news.Title: 證交所台股儀表板9/23上線　整合3大類重要資訊
news.Content:
（中央社記者曾仁凱、高華謙台北2026年09月22日電）台灣證券交易所為提升證券市場資訊透明度，今天宣布全新「台股儀表板」將於23日正式上線，投資人可透過證交所官網進入儀表板介面，首波整合證券商授信業務、投資人違約概況，以及上市櫃公司營收3大類重要資訊。

證交所表示，今年以來台股指數及成交量值均有明顯成長，市場對於融資、擔保維持率、違約等相關數據關注度提高。由於市場上數據很多，不同數據的定義、比較基礎及代表意義不完全相同，投資人從片段資訊解讀市場，不如把重要數據集中呈現，讓數據自己說話。

證交所說明，台股儀表板首波上線內容包括3大面向。一是證券商授信業務，除市場近期關注的「全市場擔保維持率」外，也包括追繳處分戶數及金額、融資餘額、信用交易成交值，以及不限用途款項借貸、借券及借券賣出等交易業務資訊。

二是投資人違約概況，提供違約總人數、違約買進賣出合計總金額，以及個別證券達違約資訊揭露標準等資訊。三是上市櫃公司營收，提供全體上市櫃公司單月及累計營收、月增率及年增率，並呈現各產業營收成長、衰退情形與最近1年趨勢。

在資料更新方面，證交所表示，儀表板的交易類資訊每日更新，隔日即可查詢前一交易日資料，圖表預設呈現最近5個交易日資訊；上市櫃公司營收資訊則按月更新。投資人並可依上市、上櫃及全市場等不同角度查看相關資訊，大幅減少自行跨平台蒐集、彙整及比對資料所需時間。

證交所表示，此次推出台股儀表板，希望透過視覺化及易於理解的方式完整呈現，協助投資人掌握台股市場現況與長期變化。證交所強調，9月23日上線只是第一步，未來將持續觀察市場發展及投資人需求，逐步充實指標及功能，讓儀表板成為投資人觀察台股重要且友善的資訊入口。

金管會證期局副局長黃仲豪指出，包括信用交易擔保維持率、不限用途款項借貸相關統計、違約總人數等都是過去沒有對外公布的數據。

針對未來精進方向，黃仲豪說，將考慮擴充歷史資料庫，也還在討論是否要納入個股，待儀表板上線後持續蒐集外界意見，也許年底前再開會討論如何修正。

news.Title: 《陸股》滬指漲0.06%、惟日K翻黑；科創50漲0.46%
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-09-22 17:03:11 數位內容中心 發佈

中國A股主要指數今(22)日收盤漲跌互現，上證指數收於3,952.13點，上漲0.06%，惟日K翻黑；深證成指收於13,723.74點，下跌0.05%；創業板指收於3,399.93點，上漲0.01%；科創50收於1,665.04點，上漲0.46%。盤勢呈現衝高回檔後的震盪分化，科創50相對較強，深證成指則偏弱。

成交量方面，滬市今成交1兆80億元(人民幣,下同)，深市成交1兆1,276億元，兩市成交額2兆1,356億元，較前一交易日量增約5%。

從盤面上來看，資金持續集中在AI應用、算力晶片、半導體與儲存晶片，帶動相關指標早盤走揚，午後雖有回吐，但整體仍維持熱度。

AI應用概念方面，智度股份、新炬網絡、中新賽克等個股表現活躍，題材熱度延續。中新賽克午後一度成為網路安全概念焦點，AI應用與端側AI成為盤面主要亮點之一。

算力與晶片方面，旋極信息、禾盛新材、綜藝股份漲停，時空科技也因儲存晶片概念走強；摩爾線程、瀾起科技、兆易創新盤中同樣活躍，算力晶片與儲存晶片同步發力，成為撐盤主軸。

相較之下，航運概念轉弱，招商輪船、招商南油等承壓，海運相關族群整體回檔。收盤時，全市場超過3,000檔個股下跌，顯示資金在高檔題材間輪動，尾盤回吐壓力仍在。

《陸股》滬指漲0.28%、日K連二紅；科創50跌0.69%

news.Title: 台股創新高48601點！股王衝破2萬天價　分析師：Q4上看53000點
news.Content:
台股今天早盤氣勢如虹，一度猛漲882點，改寫歷史新高48601，可惜隨著南韓股市尾盤走弱，漲點逐步收斂，終場僅上漲81點，收在全天最低點47800，高低相差801點，也未能守住4萬8千點。

不過，台股今天仍創下歷史收盤新高，成交量放大到1兆232億元。

股王信驊早盤一度漲停，攻上21800元，是史上首見的2萬元股王，雖然尾盤漲勢壓回，但仍上漲5.4％，收在20905元，亦即買一張要投入2090萬5千元，讓人大開眼界。

另外，創意、力旺、欣興、南電都攻上漲停，成為多頭強勢指標。

可惜的是，台積電由紅翻黑，盤中高低價相差50元，終場下跌0.81％，拖累台股氣勢；聯發科盤中再創歷史新高價5480元，但尾盤收斂至5180元，上漲3.3％。

「只要油價回穩，利率走低，第四季台股站穩5萬點，上看53000點，應該都沒問題！」摩爾投顧分析師林漢偉說，操作上，還是圍繞著AI供應鏈，首選法人加碼與集團作帳，例如台積電、聯電、聯發科等集團股。

00412A安聯亞洲半導體主動式ETF基金經理人蕭惠中表示，油價與美國10年期公債殖利率同步回落，有助改善市場風險情緒，讓近期承受壓力的科技股重獲資金青睞。從近期盤勢觀察，市場資金已逐步回流具備長線成長題材的科技與半導體產業。

蕭惠中指出，中美高層即將展開會談，加上AI產業持續推出新產品與新應用，均有助提振市場信心。然而，真正牽動科技股評價的核心因素，仍在於利率與公債殖利率走勢。若美債殖利率維持相對低檔，高成長科技股面臨的評價壓力可望進一步緩解，進而支撐後續市場表現。

在此背景下，半導體設計、晶圓代工、封裝測試及IC設計等族群有望同步受惠，AI伺服器供應鏈也可望持續吸引市場資金關注。此外，若市場預期中美關係短期趨於和緩，科技出口相關族群的投資情緒亦有機會進一步改善。

蕭惠中強調，短期波動來自情緒與利率變化，長期成長則來自真實需求。隨著市場資金逐步由題材面回歸基本面，具備技術門檻、訂單能見度及產業競爭優勢的亞洲半導體龍頭企業，仍將是AI浪潮下最具成長潛力的核心投資標的。

大華銀投信指數量化投資部門主管郭修誠表示，在全球AI軟硬體供應鏈中，美國掌控算力研發與軟體生態、台灣引領晶片代工與光通訊封裝、韓國則壟斷核心記憶體產能，三者緊密鏈結構築出無法撼動的「美台韓AI黃金三角」，宣告AI半導體行情可望延續至2027年。

郭修誠指出，當前全球AI發展已由第一階段的基礎算力建置，邁入算力擴張與硬體規格全面升級的黃金時刻。隨著新一代GPU平台與大型語言模型規模急速擴大，資料傳輸與記憶體頻寬成為算力效能能否完全釋放的關鍵瓶頸。瑞銀等國際機構上調資本支出預估，證實全球科技巨頭對AI基礎建設的投資絲毫未減，反而因內存價格勁揚與設備升級而持續擴大支出規模，這不僅奠定了未來數年的高成長格局，更將推升AI硬體產業鏈邁向2027年的高速AI黃金期。

郭修誠表示，面對AI供應鏈跨國分工的宏觀浪潮，投資人若僅單一布局特定市場，容易錯失其他供應鏈環節的成長機會。不妨透過大華銀投信透過旗下三大旗艦級ETF打造一站購足美、台、韓三國頂尖AI

news.Title: 彭金隆秋節釋利多 亞資2業務落地、台股儀表板明上線
news.Content:
金管會主委 彭金隆 今天(22日)在中秋節前舉行媒體座談會，除了分享兒時懷念的客家「月光餅」純樸滋味，也闡述金管會下一階段「市場卓越發展計畫」。彭金隆表示，亞洲資產管理中心高雄專區預計於10月初正式公布落地的兩大業務；另外，外界關注的台股儀表板也將在明天(23日)正式上線。

金管會主委彭金隆表示，台灣的金融市場必須升級，「市場卓越發展計畫」中的5大面向，除了推動亞洲資產管理中心建置、打造國際級的資本市場、也包括推動全齡金融、三軌金融(傳統金融、數位金融、區塊鏈金融)以及信任金融。

推動「亞洲資產管理中心」是近年金管會最核心的政策之一。彭金隆也表示，今年7月於高雄專區提出的規劃已進入法制作業尾聲，預計於10月初正式公布首波落地的兩大業務，包含「家族辦公室顧問業務」及「放寬特定壽險商品」。至於市場高度關注的專區示範作業準則，也預計最晚在10月底前對外放寬，屆時將一口氣鬆綁多項指標性專案，包括每檔私募基金99人申購限制、國內銀行跨境轉介開戶服務、境外高資產客戶遠距投保、高資產客戶委託投資外國虛擬資產ETF，以及創新保險預繳專戶等。

另外，彭金隆也宣布，外界關注的「台股儀表板」也將在23日於證交所和證券櫃檯買賣中心正式上線，透過各項指標數據，讓各界更清楚台灣產業整體趨勢。彭金隆說：『(原音)我們也整合我們上市櫃營收跟基本面的趨勢，讓各位能夠充分掌握到我們所有上市櫃公司整體的營收跟成長的走勢。特別這次也增加我們所有上市櫃公司營收成長跟衰退產業的數字分布，讓各位更清楚知道台灣產業整體的走勢。』

證期局副局長黃仲豪也進一步指出，「台股儀表板」優先整合推出「授信業務」、「違約概況」及「上市櫃公司營收」3大面向資訊，包含信用交易的擔保維持率與追繳處分戶數及金額、不限用途款項借貸融通餘額與擔保維持率、全市場違約總人數，及營收變化與產業別趨勢等指標，過往多數都沒有對外提供，如今投資人將更瞭解市場重要資訊，部分指標也會加註定義說明與風險警語，引導大眾以真實、客觀的數據理性判斷市場變化，並強化投資風險控管意識。(編輯：宋皖媛)

news.Title: 散戶不當冤大頭！「台股儀表板」明上線 3大數據避開斷頭危機
news.Content:
台股今日早盤衝上48000點，雖然長假前調節，終場收47,800.17點，再創歷史新高，上漲81點。金管會宣布，23日「台股儀表板」將上線，儀錶板上將針對「授信情形」、「台股的違約情形」以及「上市櫃公司營收」等三大面向資訊。

金管會表示，資訊內容包含擔保品維持率與追繳處分戶數及金額，不限用途款項借貸融資餘額與擔保維持率、全市場違約總人數即營收變化與產業等指標，協助投資人了解市場重要資訊。

在操作介面與使用者體驗上，台股儀表板的設計有別於過去「繁複」、「冷硬」的表格，以清晰直觀的視覺化呈現，預設顯示最近5個交易日的動態走勢，並且提供歷史資料查詢功能。另外，為了深化投資人教育，部分指標會加註定義說明與風險警語，引導大眾以真實、客觀的數據理性判斷市場變化，強化投資市場控管意識。

「台股儀表板」，明日(9月23日)在分別是台灣證交所、櫃買中心兩官網同步上線，為資本市場提供兼具透明度與實用性的專業數據指南。

金管會主委彭金隆出席記者會，慶賀中秋節。且未來公開資料會繼續增加，不斷滾動式檢討，包括該如何解讀這些重要數據，也會提供更專業的參考方式。

同時彭金隆也在記者會上介紹月光餅，客家傳統的「月光餅」是他從小最期待的中秋節食品，月光餅就是蕃薯餅，在客家傳統也稱為「團圓餅」，也祝福民眾在中秋節團圓快樂。

news.Title: 台股週漲近千點誰最受惠？0050、00918、00919…高股息ETF現買盤分流 上週吸金榜1表看
news.Content:
台股多頭攻勢延續，加權指數自11日的46,184.85點攀升至18日的47,180.75點，單週上漲995.90點、漲幅2.16%。截至上週五（18日）收盤，元大台灣50(0050)單週規模暴增537.11億元居各ETF之冠，整體規模達到2兆4,246.72億元；元大高股息(0056)增加205.25億元排名第二，元大台灣50正2(00631L)則增加162.68億元居第三名。

0050增加537億 流通單位反減少

統計顯示，0050單週流通受益權單位數縮減約300萬個，0056與富邦台50(006208)持平，國泰永續高股息(00878)減少約700萬單位。法人指出，這些指標型ETF規模擴張，主要受成分股股價走揚推升淨值帶動，並非等額的資金淨流入。

不過，0050單週受益人仍增加28,259人，0056與00878亦分別增加3,575人及3,008人。「受益人數增加、發行單位卻減少」的現象，顯示小額投資人持續進場，部分大額持有人則在大盤高檔進行部位調節。

00918、00919淨值回檔現申購潮

相較於市值型ETF，高股息族群走勢呈現分歧。大華優利高填息30(00918)單週淨值下跌3.20%，規模仍增加68.83億元，流通單位擴增3.31億個，受益人增加30,366人；群益台灣精選高息(00919)淨值下跌1.45%，流通單位增加4.19億個，受益人增加33,087人。

其中00918適逢除息，淨值下滑主要受除息除權影響，未代表同幅度投資損失，反而帶動買盤逢低進場卡位息收；復華台灣科技優息(00929)單週規模增加74.97億元，淨值、流通單位數與受益人數呈現同步成長。

主動式竄出 正2規模同步升溫

非傳統被動式ETF方面，主動中信台灣收益(00406A)單週規模增加72.61億元、受益人增加30,249人，其中約66.99億元增幅來自新增申購單位，規模擴張與實質申購需求高度連動。

news.Title: 創意HBM4E IP獲ASIC客戶採用，導入台積電最先進N2P與封裝技術
news.Content:
【財訊快報／記者李純君報導】創意電子（GUC）(3443)宣布，其HBM4E PHY與Controller IP已完成設計定案，並已獲客戶AI ASIC採用，且該設計採用台積電（TSMC）(2330)最先進的N2P製程與CoWoS-L封裝技術。創意提到，新一代HBM4E IP在所有可操作條件下，將資料傳輸速度提升至16Gbps，且透過創意專有的interposer佈線技術，該IP針對訊號完整性（SI）與電源完整性（PI）進行最佳化，可支援多種台積電CoWoS封裝架構。

為支援3D SoIC架構，創意HBM4E IP提供專為台積電SoIC-X技術設計的face-up版本。該IP整合專用Through-Silicon Vias（TSVs），以支援訊號輸出與輸入，以及向上層晶片提供電源（feedthrough power delivery），為複雜的3D整合架構建立完整的連接路徑。

創意的HBM4E IP亦整合proteanTecs的互連監測技術，大幅提升PHY測試與特性分析之可視性，並強化終端產品於實際運行時的效能與可靠度。

創意技術長Igor Elkanovich表示：「HBM4E在頻寬與系統層級效能方面，為新一代AI加速器帶來重大突破。透過整合我們的face-up HBM、face-up UCIe與 GLink-3D IP，創意提供完整的3D SoIC架構介面IP解決方案，使客戶能夠無縫整合HBM、Chiplet與3D堆疊，並充分發揮最先進製程技術的效能。」

news.Title: 〈陸股盤後〉習近平應邀本周訪美 三大指數漲跌互見
news.Content:
中國A股三大指數周二（22日）收盤漲跌互見，據《央視》周一報導，應美國總統川普邀請，中國國家主席習近平將於9月23日至25日對美國進行國是訪問。

上證指數周二收報3,952.13點，漲0.06%。深證成指收報13,723.74點，跌0.05%。創業板指收報3,399.93點，漲0.01%。

美國財政部長貝森特表示，在美中元首本周舉行峰會前夕，他與中國中方官員就人工智慧（AI）、貿易與投資等議題展開的會談「非常成功」。

貝森特在紐約與中國國務院副總理何立峰等官員進行數小時會談後向記者表示，雙方同意建立AI對話機制，並就共同目標與威脅交換意見。

貝森特說：「美方提議在兩國之間建立通報機制，我們希望對共同目標與共同威脅形成一致看法。」他指出，這項機制將命名為「美中AI對話」。

美國貿易代表葛里爾表示，雙方正在為川普與習近平周四會談奠定基礎。

貝森特與何立峰上一次面對面會談，是約四個月前在首爾附近舉行，當時距離川普5月訪問北京僅數日。

川普周四將在白宮接待習近平，這也是習近平十多年來首度訪美。此次會談的首要議題之一，是延長美中貿易休戰協議。雙方先前均調降關稅並放寬出口限制，但相關協議將於11月到期。

news.Title: 8月台股反彈　全體證券商獲利274億元月增1.5倍
news.Content:

今年前8月全體證券商稅後淨利1824.73億元，較去年同期大幅成長195.05%。

證交所分析，今年前8月因大盤總成交值增加，全體證券商經紀業務獲利1453.98億元，年增率達152.69%；同期自營出售證券利益也較多，全體證券商自營業務淨利654.8億元，較去年同期大幅成長3.33倍；前8月全體證券商承銷業務淨利155.92億元，也年增200.54%。

news.Title: 台股創高驚見超長上影線 分析師曝3大警訊：漲勢要結束了
news.Content:
台股今（22）日再創新高，一度衝上4萬8601點，但隨後賣壓湧現，終場僅上漲81.33點，收在4萬7800.17點，台積電盤中一度衝上2510元，接近尾盤翻黑，以2460元作收。分析師顧奎國在個人影音中表示，台股這波漲勢可能已接近尾聲，預期從周三開始，盤勢震盪將明顯加劇。

顧奎國指出，台股本波上漲至今日，多方轉折可能告一段落，尤其周三起震盪幅度勢必擴大，接下來大盤能否續攻或轉跌，關鍵仍在台積電。雖然他認為台積電後市仍有機會上看2670元至2705元，但短線面臨2500元至2535元的壓力區，進一步上攻空間有限。

除了台積電上攻動能受到壓抑，台股成交量也成為另一項警訊。顧奎國指出，昨日台股成交量明顯萎縮至約8200億元，呈現量價背離現象；上檔還面臨1.6兆至1.8兆元的歷史大量密集套牢區，若量能無法放大，指數容易拉回。

另一項值得留意的訊號則是個股漲跌結構。今日下跌家數多於上漲家數，約6成個股不漲反跌，顧奎國分析，這顯示指數雖然維持高檔，但主要仍是由台積電等大型權值股撐盤，市場整體上漲動能並不算全面。

顧奎國也提到，上周五台股大漲時，官股單日賣超達235.78億元，創近期最大賣超紀錄，從歷史數據觀察，官股若在指數相對高檔出現大量賣超，通常1至2個交易日後，盤面容易出現高點轉折。不過，他也強調，官股賣超不代表看壞後市，而是可能基於穩定金融市場與保留資金的考量，待市場拉回時再進場護盤。

面對即將到來的中秋連假，顧奎國建議，若連假前台股指數逼近高檔壓力區，可適度減碼、降低持股水位並提高現金比重；若指數在連假前拉回至相對低檔區，則可考慮增加持股比重、抱股過節，他強調，目前多頭基本面仍未改變。

news.Title: 國內首檔聚焦中小股本主動台股ETF　台新00416A幫你挖掘成長潛力股！
news.Content:
國內第一檔聚焦中小股本的台股主動式ETF：台新臺灣中小主動式ETF（00416A）來囉！台新投信率先業界推出該檔ETF，將於10/5開始募集，訴求為投資人篩選30-60檔個股，其中，60％為中小型股，40％為大型股，並將視情況機動調整，例如拉高中小型股比重至80％，力拚中小利基股的長線爆發力行情。

00416A預計以科技股為主要佈局領域，預估將佈局台光電、創意、環球晶、南電、台積電、聯發科等等個股，採季配息，發行價10元，亦即買1張只要1萬元，小資族也能擁有前述高價股。

台新投信指出，回顧2026年，市場聚焦權值股，使得台股投資以「買方向」為優先並重壓權值股；展望2027年，台股獲利增速換檔與供應鏈分化，超額報酬核心將由「題材上漲」走向「獲利兌現與企業差異」，將造就台股主動選股新浪潮，ETF資金漸往小股本靠攏，中小股本公司更有表現空間。

台新投信總經理葉柱均提醒，小股本不等於小市值，具有潛力的公司，即便股本雖小，股價爆發力也可能不輸給權值股，況且00416A一樣可以買大型股，操作彈性靈活。

台新臺灣中小主動式ETF基金（00416A）經理人，將由沈建宏擔任，他目前也是台新2000高科技基金經理人，截至今年8月底，該檔基金1年期績效高達146.4％，3年期績效310.1％，5年期績效377.6％。

沈建宏表示，美國期中選舉將於11月舉行，根據歷史經驗來看，在美國總統任期中，美股在第2年期中選舉前半年呈現低報酬、高波動特徵，但隨著民調逐漸明朗，市場信心在接近選舉日及選後快速修復，加上2027年美股企業獲利持續成長，配合往年大選前一年通常是總統任期內股市表現最佳的一年，預期第4季美股有望重啟漲勢，屆時台股追隨美股節奏，延續2027年的多頭行情。

據統計，美國期中選舉後3月、6月與一年之台股報酬，股本低於80億的中小型股平均報酬皆優於股本大於80億的大型股。

00416A是目前國內唯一高度鎖定股本80億(含)以下、基本面強、成長潛力佳的個股的台股主動式ETF。主要是看好小股本籌碼輕，更具股價爆發力，運用經理人洞察好時機，主動挖掘基本面強，未來具成長潛力的小股本公司，完整布局台灣六大AI浪潮優勢產業鏈。

沈建宏表示，高盛證券預估，AI算力需求將以每年約400%的速度爆發式增長，AI仍在成長趨勢上，台股企業獲利2026~2027年增率皆有20%以上的成長，台股後市仍有機會創新高，中小利基股表現可望勝出。

news.Title: History Says a $1,000 Investment in Broadcom Will Be Worth This Much by 2028
news.Content:
Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO) may be one of the most underrated stocks in the stock market. If you asked an average investor to rank the 10 largest companies in the world by market cap, it would probably get left out or missed most often. Investors don't realize how big Broadcom already is (it's a $1.7 trillion business), but after the massive growth it's expected to undergo, it could be worth far more.

Broadcom is tapping into a major share of the AI computing market with its custom AI chips, and this sector could be a major driver of growth, pushing Broadcom's stock to new heights over the next few years.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

But what will a $1,000 investment be worth by 2028? Let's crunch the numbers, as it could be one of the best investments to make right now.

What are ASICs?

A rapidly growing part of Broadcom's business is ASICs, or application-specific integrated circuits. ASICs have been around for a long time in many industries to do specific tasks. However, they've only recently entered the AI scene, and Broadcom is one of the biggest names in the space.

Currently, GPUs dominate the AI computing landscape. These units are fantastic for a wide variety of workloads, but aren't cheap. Furthermore, many GPUs run one type of workload throughout their service life, so some of these incredible capabilities go unused.

In their place, Broadcom is designing ASICs, or custom AI chips, to replace GPUs in repetitive tasks. By designing them specifically for a workload, Broadcom can achieve better performance at a cheaper price tag -- a win-win for everyone involved.

However, Broadcom must design them for a specific workload, so it cannot just offer ASICs on the marketplace. Instead, it must partner directly with AI firms to design a computing unit to their specs, then sell it back to them as a completed unit. An increasing number of AI firms are doing this, with some of Broadcom's biggest clients including Alphabet , Meta Platforms , OpenAI, and Anthropic. These four companies are increasingly purchasing custom AI chips tailored to their workloads, boosting Broadcom's business.

During Q3 of fiscal year 2026, ending Aug. 2, Broadcom delivered $16.7 billion in AI semiconductor revenue, up 221% year over year. That's some solid growth, but Broadcom is far from done.

Story Continues

The company expects its custom AI chip sales to really pick up, with FY 2026's AI semiconductor sales estimated to top $65 billion, FY 2027's to rise to $115 billion, and FY 2028's to reach $230 billion. That's a rapid growth trajectory, and it suggests Broadcom will deliver huge gains as a stock. But what will a $1,000 investment be worth by 2028?

Broadcom is a no-brainer stock to buy now

Broadcom has earned its place among the best big tech companies with its rapid growth and solid execution. As a result, I think a long-term valuation multiple of 30 times earnings seems reasonable. While earnings per share forecasts are typically limited to the current and next year, some forecasts are available for two years out.

Right now, Wall Street analysts estimate Broadcom's average earnings per share for its 2028 fiscal year at $28.08. At 30 times earnings, the stock would be valued at $842 per share. With the stock trading for about $360 right now, that indicates potential upside of 134%.

That would turn a $1,000 investment into $2,340 in just over two years. That's a solid return on investment, and I think it makes Broadcom a top AI stock to buy right now.

news.Title: Microsoft’s Higher Dividend Comes with a Modest Yield and Heavy AI Spending
news.Content:
Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ: MSFT ) has raised its quarterly dividend to $0.98 per share from $0.91, an increase of 7 cents, or about 8%. The new dividend is payable on December 10 to shareholders of record as of November 19. This marks another annual increase for Microsoft and extends its dividend-growth streak to 23 consecutive years.

At the new rate, Microsoft will pay $3.92 per share annually. Based on the stock price around the time of the announcement, that translates to a dividend yield of roughly 0.8%. That is a modest yield, so Microsoft's appeal as a dividend stock comes less from current income and more from the combination of dividend growth and the company's ability to generate substantial cash.

Pixabay/Public Domain

Microsoft's Balance Sheet Provides a Solid Cushion for Dividend Investors

The biggest positive for the dividend is Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT)'s enormous cash-generating capacity. In fiscal 2026, the company generated $182.9 billion in operating cash flow, up sharply from the prior year. It also returned more than $43 billion to shareholders through dividends and buybacks during the year.

The dividend therefore remains comfortably supported by Microsoft's underlying cash generation. Microsoft declared approximately $27 billion in dividends during fiscal 2026, compared with $182.9 billion of operating cash flow. Even after its enormous investments in infrastructure, the company has maintained enough financial flexibility to continue returning capital to shareholders.

The balance sheet also provides an additional cushion. Microsoft had $76.8 billion in cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments at the end of fiscal 2026, while management said its existing liquidity and cash flows should be sufficient to fund dividends, buybacks, debt maturities and capital expenditures for the foreseeable future.

There is also room for future dividend growth. The new $0.98 quarterly payout represents only a fraction of Microsoft's earnings and cash generation. The company generated $133.7 billion of GAAP net income in fiscal 2026, while the latest dividend increase was 8%. That gives Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) considerable flexibility to continue raising the payout without putting significant pressure on its finances.

Microsoft's AI Investment Boom Could Slow Dividend Growth

The biggest drawback is the low starting yield. At roughly 0.8%, Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT)'s dividend provides relatively little current income compared with traditional income-oriented stocks. Investors buying Microsoft primarily for dividend income would need to rely heavily on future dividend increases and potential capital appreciation rather than the current payout.

Story Continues

More importantly, Microsoft's massive AI infrastructure spending is putting increasing pressure on free cash flow. In the June quarter, Microsoft generated $55.4 billion of operating cash flow but only $19.6 billion of free cash flow, as capital expenditures reached $41 billion. Management expects fiscal 2027 capital expenditures to grow again, with first-quarter spending expected to exceed $50 billion.

That spending could limit how quickly Microsoft raises its dividend. The latest 8% increase was already below its roughly 10% average annual dividend growth over the past five years, according to Barron's. The difference matters because Microsoft's earnings and cash flows are growing rapidly, but management is simultaneously committing enormous amounts of capital to data centers, GPUs and other AI infrastructure.

The pressure is particularly visible in free cash flow. While operating cash flow increased strongly in fiscal 2026, Microsoft's additions to property and equipment jumped to $115.9 billion from $64.6 billion a year earlier. That means the company's ability to convert its growing operating cash flow into freely deployable cash is being constrained by its AI investment cycle.

Conclusion

Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT)'s latest dividend increase reinforces its strong dividend-growth profile, supported by robust cash flows and a low payout burden. However, its roughly 0.8% yield offers limited current income, while heavy AI infrastructure spending could moderate the pace of future dividend growth.

news.Title: Applied Materials Commits $5 Billion to India as Chip Manufacturing Expands
news.Content:
Applied Materials, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMAT ) plans to invest $5 billion in India over the next decade, expanding its research, supply-chain, and workforce capabilities as India tries to establish itself as a major semiconductor manufacturing hub.

The announcement came at SEMICON India, where more than 600 companies from 52 countries participated. India has committed more than $21 billion in semiconductor incentives and expects domestic semiconductor consumption to reach $110 billion by 2030. Applied's investment is therefore aimed at building a longer-term presence in an emerging semiconductor ecosystem rather than generating an immediate revenue contribution.

India Investment Could Expand Applied Materials' Long-Term Growth

The investment could give Applied Materials, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMAT) an early position in a market that is attempting to diversify semiconductor production beyond established hubs such as China and Taiwan. India has already approved 12 semiconductor projects under its incentive program, while commercial production has begun at some chip-packaging facilities. As more fabs and packaging facilities become operational, Applied could capture demand for deposition, etch, inspection, packaging, and other process equipment. Its existing portfolio spans these manufacturing stages, giving the company multiple opportunities to participate as India's ecosystem develops.

The investment also fits Applied's current growth cycle. In fiscal Q3 2026, revenue reached a record $9.12 billion, up 25% year over year, while gross margin rose to 50.3% and operating income increased to $3.08 billion. Applied generated a record $3.04 billion in operating cash flow during the quarter. The company has said strong AI-driven demand is supporting leading-edge logic, DRAM and advanced packaging, while it expects semiconductor-equipment growth to remain strong through 2027. A larger Indian R&D and supply-chain footprint could therefore support capacity and customer diversification as semiconductor investment expands globally.

Applied Materials Faces Execution Risks With Its India Expansion

The biggest risk is that India's semiconductor ambitions may take considerably longer to translate into equipment revenue. Reuters reported that India still has no large-scale chip fabrication facility in commercial production, while Tata Electronics' planned $10 billion fab in Gujarat has been delayed by nearly two years. That means Applied Materials, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMAT) could commit substantial capital well before the local customer base generates meaningful equipment demand. The $5 billion commitment spread over ten years also represents a long-duration capital allocation rather than an immediate earnings catalyst.

Story Continues

The investment could also pressure returns if India's manufacturing buildout progresses more slowly than expected. Applied already faces significant geopolitical exposure: its SEC filing says export restrictions have limited its China market and increased exposure to Chinese competitors. The company also paid $253 million in 2026 to settle a U.S. Commerce Department inquiry involving certain China shipments. At the same time, investors have questioned whether Applied can maintain its recent growth and margins; Reuters noted that its fourth-quarter revenue forecast of $10.25 billion came with a roughly 50.4% margin outlook amid increasing competition. Expanding in India could diversify geopolitical exposure, but it does not eliminate execution, regulatory, or capital-allocation risks.

Conclusion

Applied Materials, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMAT)'s $5 billion India commitment strengthens its long-term positioning in a market targeting $110 billion of semiconductor consumption by 2030, while aligning with the company's need to expand capacity as AI drives demand for advanced chips and packaging. The main limitation is timing: India's fab ecosystem remains immature, with major projects still facing delays. Consequently, the investment is more directly relevant to Applied's long-term geographic diversification and competitive positioning than to near-term revenue or earnings.

news.Title: Why Intel, Arm, and Other AI Chip Stocks Soared Today
news.Content:
Meta Platform 's (NASDAQ: META) new Muse personal artificial intelligence (AI) agent is off to a fast start.

After being the most downloaded free iPhone app in the U.S. for the past three days, according to Sensor Tower, Muse has investors excited about a potential boom in AI agent-fueled sales of central processing units (CPUs).

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

That, in turn, is driving up the stock prices of the leading CPU makers. Here's how some of the top AI chip stocks performed on Monday:

Arm Holdings (NASDAQ: ARM), up 17%

Intel (NASDAQ: INTC), up 12%

Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ: AMD), up 10%

Meta's Muse is grabbing investors' attention

Meta's new AI agent promises to quickly, easily, and securely perform multiple tasks for users, such as sorting email, booking reservations, and managing calendars.

Muse is more accessible than other popular agentic AI projects, such as OpenClaw. It's also backed by Meta's tremendous data collection and distribution capabilities, thanks to the social media giant's staggering 3.6 billion daily active users.

In turn, analysts believe Muse has the potential to attract hundreds of millions of users in the coming months. That would likely make it the most popular AI agent on the market.

AI agents are set to boost demand for CPU makers

While AI model training requires mostly GPU-based compute, agentic AI is powered more by inference, which requires a greater proportion of CPUs to handle tasks like planning and orchestration.

A forthcoming wave of agentic AI-powered applications is thus expected to drive demand for CPUs sharply higher in the coming years. ARM sees the server CPU market surging by 35% annually to $120 billion by 2030, while AMD predicts 50% annual growth to $220 billion by the end of the decade.

As the leading designers of CPUs and related infrastructure, Intel, AMD, and Arm stand to profit handsomely from these trends.
